C. 我們正在更換展廳裡所有的燈泡
D. 設計師對展廳的照明非常滿意
normal.explain: 原句：The lighting in this exhibition hall is designed to be adjustable. (這個展廳的燈光設計成可以調整的。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The controversial artwork must have provoked a strong reaction from the audience.
options: A. 觀眾對這件藝術品完全沒有興趣
B. 藝術家對於觀眾的反應感到很失望
C. 這件充滿爭議的藝術品一定引起了觀眾的強烈反應
D. 這件藝術品因為損壞而被緊急撤下
normal.explain: 原句：The controversial artwork must have provoked a strong reaction from the audience. (這件充滿爭議的藝術品一定引起了觀眾的強烈反應。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: These historical artifacts are considered to be priceless by experts.
options: A. Yes, they hold immense cultural value.
B. I will check the price tag later.
C. The experts must have bought them all.
D. We have been selling them cheaply.
normal.explain: 原句：These historical artifacts are considered to be priceless by experts. (專家認為這些歷史文物是無價之寶。) 選項 A (是的，它們具有極大的文化價值) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The gallery has been hosting contemporary artists to attract a younger crowd.
options: A. 畫廊一直在舉辦當代藝術家展覽以吸引年輕族群
B. 很多年輕人拒絕參觀這間傳統畫廊
C. 畫廊已經決定不再展出當代藝術品
D. 當代藝術家們正在畫廊裡進行抗議
normal.explain: 原句：The gallery has been hosting contemporary artists to attract a younger crowd. (畫廊一直在舉辦當代藝術家展覽以吸引年輕族群。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The visiting team's momentum must have been disrupted by that foul.
options: A. 那個犯規一定打亂了客隊的氣勢
B. 客隊因為犯規被裁判直接取消資格
C. 客隊在犯規後反而越打越好
D. 主場球隊的氣勢受到了極大的影響
normal.explain: 原句：The visiting team's momentum must have been disrupted by that foul. (那個犯規一定打亂了客隊的氣勢。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The championship match is expected to be broadcast live globally.
options: A. Millions of fans will be watching it.
B. They must have cancelled the match.
C. We have been playing very poorly today.
D. The broadcast was interrupted yesterday.
normal.explain: 原句：The championship match is expected to be broadcast live globally. (這場冠軍賽預計將在全球進行實況轉播。) 選項 A (數百萬球迷將會觀看) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The coach has been arguing with the referee over that penalty call.
options: A. 裁判已經決定收回剛才的判罰
B. 教練因為判罰問題被請出了球場
C. 教練一直在跟裁判爭論那個罰球判決
D. 球員們正在向裁判抗議這個不公的決定
normal.explain: 原句：The coach has been arguing with the referee over that penalty call. (教練一直在跟裁判爭論那個罰球判決。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The star player is rumored to be benched due to a minor injury.
options: A. 明星球員因為重傷將錯過整個賽季
B. 傳聞明星球員因為輕傷將坐冷板凳
C. 球隊決定將受傷的明星球員交易出去
D. 明星球員已經完全康復並準備上場
normal.explain: 原句：The star player is rumored to be benched due to a minor injury. (傳聞這位明星球員因為輕傷將坐冷板凳。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They must have trained incredibly hard to reach the finals.
options: A. 他們拒絕參加決賽前的訓練
B. 訓練過度導致他們在決賽中表現不佳
C. 他們一定訓練得非常刻苦才能進入決賽
D. 教練對他們在決賽中的表現感到滿意
normal.explain: 原句：They must have trained incredibly hard to reach the finals. (他們一定訓練得非常刻苦才能進入決賽。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We have been tracking the runner's lap times throughout the tournament.
options: A. His times must have been improving steadily.
B. The tournament was cancelled last week.
C. The runner refused to track his time.
D. I have been running every morning.
normal.explain: 原句：We have been tracking the runner's lap times throughout the tournament. (在整個錦標賽期間，我們一直在追蹤這位跑者的單圈時間。) 選項 A (他的成績一定在穩定進步中) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The tactical substitution is believed to be crucial for their victory.
options: A. 他們的勝利完全是因為運氣好
B. 教練拒絕在比賽中進行任何換人
C. 這次戰術性的換人被認為對他們的勝利至關重要
D. 換下主力球員導致了這場比賽的落敗
normal.explain: 原句：The tactical substitution is believed to be crucial for their victory. (這次戰術性的換人被認為對他們的勝利至關重要。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Professional credentials are required to be submitted before the seminar.
options: A. 研討會結束後將發放專業證書
B. 專業資格證明要求在研討會前提交
C. 參與者不需要任何專業背景即可報名
D. 研討會的主辦方遺失了大家的證件
normal.explain: 原句：Professional credentials are required to be submitted before the seminar. (專業資格證明要求在研討會前提交。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: She must have expanded her network significantly at the conference.
options: A. Yes, she exchanged cards with many executives.
B. The network is currently down.
C. We have been expanding the office space.
D. She must have forgotten to attend it.
normal.explain: 原句：She must have expanded her network significantly at the conference. (她一定在會議上大幅擴展了她的人脈。) 選項 A (是的，她跟許多高層交換了名片) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been providing mentorship programs to assist mid-career transitions.
options: A. 我們一直在提供導師計畫以協助中年轉職
B. 中年轉職者拒絕參加任何導師計畫
C. 我們的導師計畫目前已經暫停招募
D. 轉職者對目前的導師計畫感到不滿
normal.explain: 原句：We have been providing mentorship programs to assist mid-career transitions. (我們一直在提供導師計畫以協助中年轉職。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The guest speaker is known to be an expert in climbing the corporate ladder.
options: A. 演講嘉賓以其在企業界晉升的專業知識而聞名
B. 嘉賓剛剛從公司的最高層職位退下來
C. 演講者拒絕透露他在企業成功的秘訣
D. 嘉賓認為在企業中晉升是一件困難的事
normal.explain: 原句：The guest speaker is known to be an expert in climbing the corporate ladder. (這位客座講者以其在企業界晉升的專業知識而聞名。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He must have prepared extensively to answer those tough interview questions.
options: A. 面試官的問題讓他感到非常不知所措
B. 他面試時完全沒有回答出那些難題
C. 他一定做了廣泛的準備才能回答那些艱難的面試問題
D. 面試官一定已經提前把問題洩露給了他
normal.explain: 原句：He must have prepared extensively to answer those tough interview questions. (他一定做了廣泛的準備才能回答那些艱難的面試問題。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I have been exploring alternative career paths since my department was downsized.
options: A. The department will be expanding soon.
B. It's a great opportunity to find what you really want.
C. You must have fired them all.
D. The paths in this park are quite narrow.
normal.explain: 原句：I have been exploring alternative career paths since my department was downsized. (自從我的部門縮編後，我一直在探索其他的職涯路徑。) 選項 B (這是一個尋找你真正想要什麼的好機會) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A positive personal brand is considered to be indispensable in today's job market.
options: A. 求職者應該盡量隱藏自己的個人品牌
B. 正向的個人品牌在現今的就業市場被認為是不可或缺的
C. 大多數公司不在乎求職者的個人品牌
D. 建立個人品牌是一件浪費時間的事情
normal.explain: 原句：A positive personal brand is considered to be indispensable in today's job market. (正向的個人品牌在現今的就業市場被認為是不可或缺的。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The seminar attendees have been sharing their resumes for peer review.
options: A. 與會者拒絕讓別人看自己的履歷
B. 專家正在台上公開評論大家的履歷
C. 研討會的與會者一直在分享他們的履歷以進行同儕審查
D. 主辦方已經把所有與會者的履歷都銷毀了
normal.explain: 原句：The seminar attendees have been sharing their resumes for peer review. (研討會的與會者一直在分享他們的履歷以進行同儕審查。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She must have secured a lucrative job offer after attending that workshop.
options: A. 她一定在參加那場工作坊後獲得了一份優渥的工作邀約
B. 工作坊的主辦方拒絕給她任何工作機會
C. 她在工作坊上表現不佳，錯失了工作機會
D. 她決定放棄那份薪水很高的工作
normal.explain: 原句：She must have secured a lucrative job offer after attending that workshop. (她一定在參加那場工作坊後獲得了一份優渥的工作邀約。)

normal.desc: 【時態】The human resources team ___ the staff's morale since the latest restructuring was announced.
options: A. has been assessing
B. assesses
C. is assessing
D. has assessed
normal.explain: 本題測驗現在完成進行式。句末的 since 表示動作從過去持續到現在，且強調持續進行的狀態，故選 has been assessing。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The anonymous survey results are reported ___ by the executive board behind closed doors yesterday.
options: A. to review
B. to have been reviewed
C. to be reviewing
D. to have reviewed
normal.explain: 本題測驗複雜被動語態。審查的動作發生在昨天（過去），因此不定詞需用完成式，且問卷結果是「被審查」，故選 to have been reviewed。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】Only half of the staff completed the questionnaire; the others ___ the due date notification.
options: A. should ignore
B. could ignore
C. must have ignored
D. might ignore
normal.explain: 本題測驗對過去事實的肯定推測。既然只有一半的人完成，其他人「一定忽略了」通知，應使用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the staff lounge closed?
B: The management ___ it for the past two weeks to create a better rest area.
options: A. renovate
B. has renovated
C. is renovated
D. has been renovating
normal.explain: 對話中提到 for the past two weeks，表示動作從過去兩週一直持續到現在還在進行中，需使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new remote work arrangement is widely considered ___ a major boost to overall staff well-being last year.
options: A. to have provided
B. to be provided
C. to provide
D. providing
normal.explain: 句中的 last year 點出提供幫助的時間點在過去，因此 consider 之後要接完成式不定詞 to have + V-p.p. 表達較早發生的動作。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You didn't receive the wellness questionnaire? The automated mail server ___ it to your spam folder by mistake.
options: A. must route
B. must have routed
C. routes
D. has routed
normal.explain: 針對過去發生的情況（沒收到信）做出強烈推斷，「一定是分類到垃圾信件匣了」，須用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】HR Notice: We have been gathering input from all departments regarding workplace stress. The long hours are suspected to have caused extreme burnout among the junior staff. Supervisors must have failed to recognize the early signs of exhaustion.
Q: What is identified as the root of the problem?
options: A. Low pay
B. Poor facilities
C. Excessive working hours
D. Lack of training
normal.explain: 短文中提到「The long hours are suspected to have caused extreme burnout」，可推知問題的根源是工時過長 (Excessive working hours)。

normal.desc:
【短文】Memo: The annual retreat has been undergoing major changes. The event is expected to be hosted locally this year to cut costs. The planning committee must have realized that international travel is no longer viable for our budget.
Q: What is true about the annual retreat?
options: A. It is canceled.
B. It is fully funded.
C. It will last longer.
D. It will take place nearby.
normal.explain: 短文中提到「hosted locally this year to cut costs」，表示今年的員工旅遊會在本地舉辦，因此地點會在附近 (nearby)。

normal.desc: 【時態】City planners ___ the traffic congestion at the main intersection for several months to find a solution.
options: A. have been observing
B. are observing
C. will observe
D. observe
normal.explain: for several months 表示動作持續了一段時間並延續至今，故選擇現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The controversial toll tax is scheduled ___ by the municipal council next spring.
options: A. to enforce
B. to be enforced
C. enforcing
D. enforce
normal.explain: 稅收 (toll tax) 是被執行的，因此在 is scheduled 之後要接被動不定詞 to be + V-p.p.。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The train arrived forty minutes late; there ___ a severe malfunction on the tracks.
options: A. must be
B. can be
C. must have been
D. will be
normal.explain: 火車已經誤點了，這是對過去發生的事件進行強烈推測，「當時軌道一定發生了故障」，所以用 must have been。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have they fixed the pothole on 5th Avenue?
B: No, the road crew ___ on the highway expansion instead.
options: A. focused
B. is focusing
C. focuses
D. has been focusing
normal.explain: 雖然沒有時間副詞，但語意上強調工程人員「這陣子一直專注於」高速公路擴建，用現在完成進行式最符合情境。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The expanded bicycle lanes are proven ___ commuting times for residents in the suburbs over the last year.
options: A. to have shortened
B. to shorten
C. shortening
D. to be shortened
normal.explain: over the last year 指向過去的成果，are proven 後方需搭配完成式不定詞 to have shortened 來表示已經發生的縮短效果。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The mayor skipped the transit ribbon-cutting ceremony. She ___ stuck in the very traffic she promised to eliminate.
options: A. is
B. must have gotten
C. will get
D. should get
normal.explain: 市長缺席了過去的典禮，推測她當時「一定被困在車陣中了」，對過去事實的推斷要用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】Public Transit Update: The city has been testing electric buses on route 42. However, the battery capacity is rumored to have fallen short of initial projections. The manufacturer must have overestimated the mileage under heavy air conditioning use.
Q: What is the problem with the new buses?
options: A. They are too noisy.
B. They are too small.
C. Their batteries drain faster than expected.
D. Their air conditioners are broken.
normal.explain: 短文中指出電池容量「fallen short of initial projections (不如預期)」，代表電力消耗比預期的更快。

normal.desc: 【時態】Health inspectors ___ local restaurants continuously to ensure proper sanitation standards are met.
options: A. patrol
B. are patrolling
C. patrolled
D. have been patrolling
normal.explain: continuously 暗示動作從過去一直持續到現在，因此選現在完成進行式最能表達「持續不斷巡查」的語意。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The contaminated batch of frozen vegetables is ordered ___ from all retail stores nationwide immediately.
options: A. to be withdrawn
B. to withdraw
C. withdrawing
D. withdrawn
normal.explain: 蔬菜是「被撤下」，在 is ordered 之後應接被動的不定詞 to be withdrawn。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】Several consumers reported food poisoning; the restaurant ___ cross-contamination in the kitchen yesterday.
options: A. must allow
B. must have allowed
C. allowed
D. has allowed
normal.explain: 句末有 yesterday，推論昨天廚房裡「一定允許/發生了」交叉污染，用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the dairy aisle empty?
B: The supermarket chain ___ a massive recall on all milk products since this morning.
options: A. execute
B. is executing
C. has been executing
D. executes
normal.explain: since this morning 表示動作從早上持續到說話的當下，需用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The viral outbreak is strongly suspected ___ by imported seafood that bypassed border checks last week.
options: A. to be caused
B. causing
C. causes
D. to have been caused
normal.explain: 疾病爆發被強烈懷疑是上週的海鮮「所引起的」。時間發生在過去且是被動，需用完成式被動不定詞 to have been caused。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】You bought that expired meat on clearance? You ___ the label closely enough before paying.
options: A. must not have read
B. should read
C. must read
D. did not read
normal.explain: 對過去事實的強烈否定推測，「當時你一定沒有仔細看標籤」，使用 must not have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】News Report: The agricultural department has been tracking a new strain of bacteria in poultry farms. The infection is believed to have spread through contaminated feed. Farm owners must have skipped the mandatory sterilization procedures during the busy holiday season.
Q: How did the bacteria likely spread?
options: A. Through the air
B. Through polluted food sources
C. Through human contact
D. Through wild birds
normal.explain: 短文中提到「spread through contaminated feed (受到污染的飼料)」，因此與 polluted food sources 意思相符。

normal.desc:
【短文】Press Release: The beverage company has been recalling thousands of glass bottles. A manufacturing flaw is confirmed to have caused the glass to shatter easily. Consumers must have experienced injuries while opening the caps.
Q: What hazard is associated with the bottles?
options: A. Toxic ingredients
B. Expired contents
C. Breakable packaging
D. Leaking caps
normal.explain: 短文中提到「caused the glass to shatter easily (導致玻璃容易碎裂)」，因此危險在於易碎的包裝 (Breakable packaging)。

normal.desc: 【時態】Ethicists ___ the potential biases in machine learning algorithms for years without finding a perfect solution.
options: A. scrutinize
B. are scrutinizing
C. will scrutinize
D. have been scrutinizing
normal.explain: for years 點出持續多年的動作，並強調一直進行到現在的狀態，因此使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The autonomous driving software is alleged ___ several traffic accidents due to sensor failure last month.
options: A. to have triggered
B. to trigger
C. triggering
D. to be triggered
normal.explain: 軟體被宣稱在「上個月」引發了事故。引發是主動動作且發生在過去，故用完成式不定詞 to have triggered。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The facial recognition system misidentified the suspect; its training data ___ diversity.
options: A. is lacking
B. must have lacked
C. lacks
D. will lack
normal.explain: 系統誤認了嫌犯（過去式），所以推測「當時的訓練資料一定缺乏多樣性」，選 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is the new AI tool replacing human writers?
B: Critics ___ about that possibility, but creativity remains uniquely human.
options: A. warn
B. are warned
C. have been warning
D. will warn
normal.explain: 雖然沒有時間副詞，但語意上強調評論家「近期以來一直在警告」這件事，故用現在完成進行式最自然。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new privacy legislation is widely acknowledged ___ tech companies to rewrite their data collection policies.
options: A. compel
B. compelling
C. to be compelled
D. to have compelled
normal.explain: 法規被廣泛承認「已經迫使」科技公司重寫政策。迫使是主動動作且已經發生，故接 to have compelled。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The chatbot generated highly offensive remarks. The developers ___ adequate content filters before the official launch.
options: A. must have omitted
B. omit
C. must omit
D. omitted
normal.explain: 因為機器人已經產生了冒犯言論，推斷開發者在發布前「一定遺漏了」過濾器。對過去事實的推測需用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】Tech Commentary: Scholars have been questioning the transparency of AI decision-making. The algorithm is known to have favored resumes with specific keywords, creating an unfair advantage. The programmers must have trained the model on historically biased hiring records.

B. Because of the flawed historical data it learned from
C. Because the candidates paid money
D. Because it randomly selected them

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The pop-up store sold out of merchandise in two hours; the promotional campaign ___ highly successful.

B. must be
C. is
D. will be

normal.desc:

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The viral marketing stunt is estimated ___ over ten million impressions within the first 24 hours of its release.

B. to generate
C. to have generated

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The competitor completely copied our promotional tactics. Someone internally ___ the campaign blueprint.

B. is leaking
C. to leak
D. must have leaked
normal.explain: 因為對手完全抄襲了，所以推測內部「一定有人洩漏了」企劃藍圖，使用 must have + V-p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】Case Study: The sportswear company has been struggling to connect with Gen Z buyers. Their recent partnership with e-sports athletes is reported to have revitalized their market share. The marketing director must have recognized the immense purchasing power of the gaming community.

normal.explain: 短文中提及「partnership with e-sports athletes (與電競選手合作)」，即指贊助遊戲玩家 (Sponsoring gamers)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Journalists have been pressing the mayor for more transparency regarding the budget deficit.
options: A. 記者們一直在施壓市長，要求對預算赤字有更高的透明度
B. 記者們對市長的預算計畫表示贊同
C. 市長一直在要求記者保持透明
D. 市長正在掩蓋預算赤字的問題
normal.explain: Journalists have been pressing the mayor for more transparency regarding the budget deficit. (記者們一直向市長施壓，要求對預算赤字保持更高的透明度。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: All pertinent documentation is mandated to be published on the official city portal.
options: A. 所有相關文件都必須發表在實體報紙上
B. 規定所有相關文件都必須發布在官方城市入口網站上
C. 市政文件不需要公開
D. 網站上的文件正在被刪除
normal.explain: All pertinent documentation is mandated to be published on the official city portal. (強制規定所有相關文件都必須公布在官方的城市入口網站上。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The sudden policy reversal must have caught the local businesses completely off guard.
options: A. They have been planning this reversal for years.
B. Indeed, many shop owners are scrambling to adapt.
C. The policy is expected to be ignored.
D. Business owners must have guarded the policy.
normal.explain: The sudden policy reversal must have caught the local businesses completely off guard. (政策突然的反覆一定讓當地企業措手不及。) 回應 B (確實，許多店主正手忙腳亂地適應) 符合情境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Our IT department has been upgrading the server infrastructure to minimize unexpected downtime.
options: A. 資訊部門一直造成系統意外當機
B. 資訊部門一直在升級伺服器基礎架構，以盡量減少意外的停機時間
C. 伺服器正在被移出基礎設施
D. 我們一直在等待伺服器自動修復
normal.explain: Our IT department has been upgrading the server infrastructure to minimize unexpected downtime. (我們的資訊部門一直在升級伺服器基礎架構，以將意外的停機時間降到最低。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The critical security patch is scheduled to be deployed across the network tonight.
options: A. 關鍵的安全修補程式預計在今晚部署到整個網路
B. 網路安全問題將在今晚被徹底忽略
C. 修補程式必須被刪除
D. 網路將在今晚永遠關閉
normal.explain: The critical security patch is scheduled to be deployed across the network tonight. (關鍵的安全修補程式預定於今晚在整個網路上部署。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The hackers must have exploited an unknown vulnerability in our legacy software.
options: A. We have been hacking the system all day.
B. Yes, the forensics team found a backdoor in the old code.
C. The vulnerability is highly anticipated.
D. They must have been very ethical.
normal.explain: The hackers must have exploited an unknown vulnerability in our legacy software. (駭客一定利用了我們舊版軟體中未知的漏洞。) 回應 B (是的，鑑識團隊在舊程式碼中發現了後門) 銜接自然。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been monitoring the network traffic for any signs of unauthorized access.
options: A. 我們正在建立新的無障礙網路
B. 我們一直在監控網路流量，以尋找未經授權存取的任何跡象
C. 我們停止監控網路，因為流量太大了
D. 授權人員一直無法存取網路
normal.explain: We have been monitoring the network traffic for any signs of unauthorized access. (我們一直在監控網路流量，留意是否有任何未經授權存取的跡象。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: User credentials are strictly required to be encrypted before transmission.
options: A. 使用者憑證在傳輸前會被解密
B. 嚴格規定使用者憑證在傳輸前必須先加密
C. 使用者憑證不需要任何保護
D. 傳輸過程被嚴格禁止
normal.explain: User credentials are strictly required to be encrypted before transmission. (嚴格規定使用者憑證在傳輸前必須進行加密。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The prolonged outage must have been caused by a massive hardware failure.
options: A. I heard the primary storage array completely burned out.
B. We have been trying to cause an outage.
C. The hardware is expected to be flawless.
D. It must have been a very quick fix.
normal.explain: The prolonged outage must have been caused by a massive hardware failure. (長時間的停機一定是因大規模硬體故障所引起的。) 回應 A (我聽說主儲存陣列完全燒毀了) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The support agents have been dealing with a surge of complaints regarding the delayed shipments.
options: A. 客服人員正在處理出貨系統的升級
B. 客服人員一直面臨大量關於貨運延遲的客訴
C. 貨物已經全數順利送達
D. 代理商正在阻止客訴的產生
normal.explain: The support agents have been dealing with a surge of complaints regarding the delayed shipments. (客服人員一直在處理因貨物延誤而激增的投訴。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The damaged goods are authorized to be disposed of by the local facility.
options: A. 當地設施被授權處理（丟棄）這些損壞的貨物
B. 當地設施拒絕接收損壞的貨物
C. 損壞的貨物必須被修復並重新出售
D. 貨物被完好無缺地保存在倉庫中
normal.explain: The damaged goods are authorized to be disposed of by the local facility. (受損的貨物被授權由當地設施進行報廢處理。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The delivery drone must have deviated from its pre-programmed route.
options: A. It has been flying perfectly on course.
B. Yes, the GPS logs show it headed into a restricted zone.
C. The drone is expected to be grounded.
D. We must have programmed the package.
normal.explain: The delivery drone must have deviated from its pre-programmed route. (送貨無人機一定是偏離了預先設定的路線。) 回應 B (是的，GPS 日誌顯示它飛進了限制區) 符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Critics have been scrutinizing the chef’s unorthodox approach to classic dishes.
options: A. 評論家們正在讚美主廚傳統的料理手法
B. 評論家們一直在嚴格審視主廚對經典菜餚的非傳統做法
C. 主廚拒絕接受任何評論家的意見
D. 這道經典菜色從未被評論過
normal.explain: Critics have been scrutinizing the chef’s unorthodox approach to classic dishes. (評論家們一直在仔細審視主廚處理經典菜餚的非正統做法。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The seasonal menu is designed to be paired with their extensive wine collection.
options: A. 季節菜單的設計是為了搭配他們豐富的葡萄酒收藏
B. 季節菜單將不提供任何酒精飲料
C. 葡萄酒收藏被賣給了其他餐廳
D. 菜單上的菜色與葡萄酒完全不搭
normal.explain: The seasonal menu is designed to be paired with their extensive wine collection. (季節性菜單是專為搭配他們豐富的葡萄酒收藏而設計的。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The culinary award must have boosted the restaurant's reputation immensely.
options: A. They have been losing customers steadily.
B. Definitely, they're fully booked for the next three months.
C. The award is considered to be fake.
D. We must have cooked the reputation.
normal.explain: The culinary award must have boosted the restaurant's reputation immensely. (這個烹飪獎項一定極大地提升了該餐廳的聲譽。) 回應 B (絕對是，他們接下來三個月的訂位都滿了) 最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The panelists have been answering challenging questions from the audience for an hour.
options: A. 座談會小組成員已經回答觀眾的尖銳問題長達一小時
B. 座談會小組拒絕回答任何問題
C. 觀眾一直在台上發表演講
D. 問題太過簡單，一小時內就問完了
normal.explain: The panelists have been answering challenging questions from the audience for an hour. (座談會的專家小組一直在回答觀眾提出的具挑戰性問題，已經持續一小時了。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The supplementary data is heavily relied upon to be conclusive.
options: A. 補充數據被認為是完全沒有用的
B. 補充數據被高度依賴以作為決定性的結論
C. 數據正在被慢慢刪除
D. 結論已經出爐，不需要補充數據
normal.explain: The supplementary data is heavily relied upon to be conclusive. (為了得出確鑿的結論，非常依賴這份補充數據。)

normal.desc: 【時態】The board of directors ___ potential mergers since the new fiscal year began.
options: A. assess
B. are assessing
C. have been assessing
D. will assess
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句尾有 since 加上過去時間點，表示從過去一直持續到現在的動作，且強調持續性，應使用現在完成進行式 (have been V-ing)。選項 C 正確。A 為現在簡單式，B 為現在進行式，D 為未來式，皆不符合時間標記。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The unprecedented revenue growth is projected ___ by a new digital infrastructure.
options: A. to drive
B. to be driven
C. driving
D. to have driven
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：project (預計) 後方接不定詞 to V，而營收成長是「被」數位基礎設施所驅動，因此需要用不定詞的被動語態 to be p.p.。選項 B 正確。A 是主動，C 是動名詞，D 是主動的完成式，皆不合語意。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】We secured the dominant market share. Our competitors ___ our aggressive expansion plan.
options: A. should dismiss
B. must have dismissed
C. can dismiss
D. ought to dismiss
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：前句提到「我們取得了主導市佔率（已發生的事實）」，後句推測對手過去一定做錯了什麼決定，表示對過去事實的強烈推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 B (一定忽視了) 正確。A 和 D 表示「應該忽視(但沒做)」，C 為現在的能力或許可，皆不合理。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The CEO highlighted the company's ___ in navigating the unpredictable supply chain disruptions.
options: A. resilience
B. transparency
C. aesthetics
D. interpretation
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：resilience 意思是「韌性、適應力」，符合句意「CEO 強調公司在應對不可預測的供應鏈中斷時所展現的韌性」。B 為透明度，C 為美學，D 為解釋，皆不符合語境。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the shareholders approve the dividend payout?
B: Yes, a generous dividend is confirmed ___ to all investors next month.
options: A. to distribute
B. distributing
C. to be distributed
D. distributed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：confirm 後方如接動作，常見為 is confirmed to V (被確認將會...)。股息 (dividend) 是「被分配」給投資人，所以要用被動語態 to be distributed。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Shareholder Letter: We have been expanding our footprint in emerging markets. This strategic ___ is anticipated to yield substantial returns by 2028. Management must have foreseen the stagnation in domestic sales.
Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. disruption
B. limitation
C. diversification
D. stagnation
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到公司一直在新興市場擴張版圖，這種「多元化/分散投資 (diversification)」預計將帶來回報。A 是中斷，B 是限制，D 是停滯，皆與擴張版圖的正面策略不符。

normal.desc:
【短文】Shareholder Letter: Our operational costs are reported to have spiked last quarter. The sudden surge in raw material prices must have caught the procurement team off guard. We have been restructuring the supplier contracts to mitigate this issue.
Q: What is the main cause of the increased costs?
options: A. The restructuring of supplier contracts
B. The drop in product quality
C. The sudden rise in raw material prices
D. The hiring of a new procurement team
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到「The sudden surge in raw material prices must have caught the procurement team off guard. (原物料價格突然飆升一定讓採購團隊措手不及)」，這正是營運成本飆升 (spiked) 的主因。選項 C 符合文章內容。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To ensure long-term stability, we plan to ___ our surplus capital into renewable energy ventures.
options: A. hinder
B. taint
C. channel
D. suppress
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：channel 在此作動詞，意為「引導、投入（資金等）」。句意為「我們計畫將剩餘資金投入再生能源事業」。A 為阻礙，B 為污染，D 為壓制，皆不符合語意。

normal.desc: 【時態】Astronomers ___ the irregular orbit of the newly discovered exoplanet for several months.
options: A. have been tracking
B. has tracked
C. track
D. are tracking
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：時間標記為 for several months，表示從過去持續到現在的動作，主詞 Astronomers 為複數，故選 have been tracking (現在完成進行式)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden mass extinction event is hypothesized ___ by a series of massive volcanic eruptions millions of years ago.
options: A. to trigger
B. to be triggering
C. to have been triggered
D. triggering
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：事件是「被」引發，故需用被動語態。又因為引發的動作發生在數百萬年前，比 is hypothesized (現在被假設) 更早發生，因此要用完成式的被動 to have been p.p.。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The fossil was found in a deep marine rock layer. The creature ___ in a shallow sea environment.
options: A. must not dwell
B. cannot have dwelled
C. should have dwelled
D. might dwell
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：化石是在「深海」岩層中發現的，因此推測該生物「不可能」棲息在淺海環境。對過去事實的強烈否定推測用 cannot (can't) have + p.p.。B 正確。A 是現在禁止，C 是過去應該做卻沒做，D 是現在或未來的弱推測。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The ability of certain bacteria to survive extreme radiation remains an intriguing ___ to modern biologists.
options: A. transparency
B. consolidation
C. enigma
D. motive
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：enigma 意指「謎、難以理解的事物」。句意為「某些細菌在極端輻射下存活的能力，對現代生物學家來說仍是個有趣的謎」。A 為透明度，B 為鞏固，D 為動機。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why are they studying these deep-sea vents?
B: The unique ecosystem there is thought ___ crucial clues about the origins of life on Earth.
options: A. to hold
B. to be held
C. holding
D. to have been held
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：is thought 後方接 to V。深海熱泉的生態系統「主動擁有/包含 (hold)」了生命起源的線索，所以用主動語態 to hold 即可，不需被動。選項 A 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Cosmos Today: The rover has been drilling into the Martian surface to collect soil samples. Traces of ancient organic molecules are confirmed to have been detected in the latest batch. The planet must have harbored liquid water at some point in its history.
Q: What does the detection of organic molecules suggest?
options: A. The rover needs maintenance
B. The planet likely had liquid water in the past
C. The drilling process is complete
D. The soil samples are contaminated
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文最後一句指出「The planet must have harbored liquid water at some point in its history. (該行星歷史上某個時期一定曾擁有液態水)」，這是基於偵測到有機分子所作出的推論。選項 B 符合。

normal.desc: 【時態】The research institute ___ funding for its controversial cloning project since the ethical debate intensified.
options: A. has been losing
B. are losing
C. is lost
D. to lose
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：since 連接過去時間 (倫理辯論加劇之時)，主要子句應使用現在完成進行式表示動作持續至今。主詞為單數，故選 has been losing。

normal.desc: 【時態】Concerned citizens ___ outside the city hall to protest the proposed zoning laws for three consecutive days.
options: A. rally
B. are rallying
C. have been rallying
D. rallied
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：有 for three consecutive days (連續三天) 的時間區段，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應選現在完成進行式 have been rallying。A 為現在簡單式，B 為現在進行式，D 為過去簡單式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The historic library in the town center is expected ___ into a commercial complex next year.
options: A. to transform
B. to be transformed
C. transforming
D. to have transformed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：圖書館是「被改建」成商業綜合體，且預期發生在明年 (next year)，is expected 後接不定詞，故選擇 to be transformed (被動)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The mayor approved the demolition of the park. He ___ the immense historical value of that green space.
options: A. must have disregarded
B. should disregard
C. can disregard
D. will disregard
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：市長已經批准了拆除案 (過去式 approved)，所以我們推論他當時「一定忽視了」那片綠地的歷史價值。對過去事實的肯定推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 A 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】It is utterly ___ that the municipal council decided to cut funding for public transportation while increasing parking fees.
options: A. immersive
B. preposterous
C. evocative
D. retrospective
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：preposterous 意為「荒謬的、乖戾的」。句意為「市議會決定削減大眾運輸資金，同時卻提高停車費，這絕對是荒謬的」。A 為沉浸式，C 為喚起情感的，D 為回顧的。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you read the editorial about the new stadium?
B: Yes, the construction costs are reported ___ the initial budget by millions of dollars.
options: A. to exceed
B. to have exceeded
C. exceeding
D. exceeded
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：are reported 後接 to V，但因為「超出預算」是已經發生的事實，比「被報導」(現在) 更早發生，因此要用完成不定詞 to have exceeded。主動語態即可，因為花費主動超出預算。

normal.desc:
【短文】Letter to the Editor: I have been living in this neighborhood for two decades. The recent surge in property taxes is alleged to have driven many long-term residents away. The local government must have forgotten that working-class families are the backbone of this community.
Q: What is the writer's main complaint?
options: A. Working-class families are causing traffic
B. The neighborhood has become too noisy
C. High property taxes are forcing long-term residents to move
D. The local government is building new houses
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：投書中提到「The recent surge in property taxes is alleged to have driven many long-term residents away (近期財產稅的飆升據稱已逼走許多長期居民)」，這是作者的主要抱怨。選項 C 符合。

normal.desc:
【短文】Reader's Voice: The sanitation department has been neglecting the waste collection schedule in the eastern district. The overflowing bins are widely recognized to be a severe public health hazard. The authorities must have diverted their resources to the wealthier neighborhoods.
Q: What does the writer suspect the authorities did?
options: A. They hired more sanitation workers
B. They redirected their resources to richer areas
C. They bought new waste bins
D. They increased the budget for the eastern district
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：作者寫道「The authorities must have diverted their resources to the wealthier neighborhoods (當局一定把資源轉移到較富裕的街區了)」。選項 B (redirected their resources to richer areas) 是 divert 的同義表達。

normal.desc: 【字彙】As a taxpayer, I demand greater ___ regarding how the infrastructure funds are being spent by the city council.
options: A. transparency
B. plumage
C. motive
D. exoplanet
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：transparency 意為「透明度」。句意：「作為納稅人，我要求市議會在如何花費基礎設施資金方面要有更高的透明度」。B 為羽毛，C 為動機，D 為系外行星。

normal.desc: 【時態】Legal experts ___ the implications of this landmark Supreme Court decision since it was announced yesterday morning.
options: A. are scrutinizing
B. have been scrutinizing
C. scrutinize
D. will scrutinize
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句子有 since + 過去時間點，表示動作從過去持續到現在，應使用現在完成進行式。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The multinational corporation is ruled ___ antitrust laws by monopolizing the software distribution market.
options: A. to have violated
B. to be violated
C. violating
D. to violate
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：法庭裁決 (is ruled) 是現在式，但公司「違反」反托拉斯法是過去已發生的動作，所以用完成不定詞 to have violated。因為公司是主動違反法律，不需被動。選項 A 正確。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The defendant fled the country hours before the verdict. He ___ a tip-off from someone inside the courthouse.
options: A. will obtain
B. must have obtained
C. should obtain
D. could obtain
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：被告在判決前幾個小時逃離國家，所以推論他過去「一定已經獲得」了內部消息。對過去的強烈推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The judge dismissed the case because the evidence presented by the prosecution was entirely ___ and lacked a solid factual basis.
options: A. circumstantial
B. immersive
C. resilient
D. transparent
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：circumstantial 意思是「依據情況的、間接的 (證據)」。circumstantial evidence 意指間接證據。句意為證據全是間接的且缺乏堅實的事實基礎，故法官駁回案件。B 沉浸式，C 有韌性的，D 透明的。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did the appellate court overturn the previous ruling?
B: The original trial is found ___ tainted by severe jury tampering.
options: A. to be
B. being
C. to have been
D. having been
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：is found 後接 to V。「原審被發現遭到陪審團干擾而受污染」，原審是過去的事，比 is found (現在) 更早發生，因此用 to have been p.p. (完成不定詞的被動形式)。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Legal Times: The pharmaceutical company has been facing a massive class-action lawsuit. Their flagship painkiller is proven to have caused severe cardiac side effects. The executives must have suppressed the clinical trial data to secure FDA approval.
Q: What did the executives allegedly do?
options: A. They recalled the painkiller
B. They hid negative medical data from the trials
C. They increased the price of the drug
D. They sued the FDA
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到 executives (高管) must have suppressed the clinical trial data (一定壓下了臨床試驗數據)。suppress 意指隱瞞、壓制。選項 B (hid negative medical data) 為同義改寫，故正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Court News Daily: The celebrity chef has been battling copyright infringement claims over his bestselling cookbook. Several recipes are deemed to have been blatantly plagiarized from a lesser-known blogger. The chef's legal team must have advised him to settle out of court to avoid further embarrassment.
Q: What is the celebrity chef accused of?
options: A. Using expired ingredients
B. Insulting a lesser-known blogger
C. Stealing recipes from someone else
D. Publishing his cookbook too late
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文指出「Several recipes are deemed to have been blatantly plagiarized (多個食譜被認為是公然抄襲)」，因此名廚被控訴的是竊取他人的食譜 (Stealing recipes)。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The defense attorney argued that his client had no ___ to commit the crime, as he stood to gain nothing from it.
options: A. interpretation
B. motive
C. retrospective
D. consolidation
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：motive 意思是「動機」。句意：「辯護律師主張他的委託人沒有犯罪動機，因為他無法從中獲利」。A 為解釋，C 為回顧，D 為鞏固。

normal.desc: 【時態】Art critics ___ the controversial installation piece since the gallery opened last Thursday.
options: A. have been praising
B. are praising
C. praised
D. praise
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句尾的 since 加上過去時間點 (last Thursday) 是現在完成式或現在完成進行式的標誌。選項 A 符合，表示從上週四開始持續讚賞到現在。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The Renaissance masterpiece is rumored ___ to the national museum by an anonymous billionaire.
options: A. to donate
B. to be donating
C. to have been donated
D. to have donated
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：畫作是「被」捐贈，且由上下文得知捐贈動作應已發生，因此在 is rumored (被謠傳) 後方使用完成式被動 to have been donated。選項 C 正確。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The lighting in the exhibition hall is perfectly designed. The curator ___ a lot of time arranging the spotlights.
options: A. must invest
B. must have invested
C. should invest
D. might invest
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：展廳的燈光設計很完美 (現在的事實)，推論館長過去「一定投入了」許多時間。對過去的肯定推測用 must have + p.p.。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The contemporary sculpture exhibition offers a deeply ___ look into the devastating effects of climate change.
options: A. evocative
B. circumstantial
C. preposterous
D. controversial
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：evocative 意思是「喚起(情感/記憶)的、引起共鳴的」。句意為該展覽對氣候變遷的破壞性影響提供了深刻且發人深省/引起共鳴的視角。B 間接的，C 荒謬的，D 具爭議的 (此處理論上也可，但 evocative 更符合藝術評論的語境與 deeply 搭配)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you see the new photography exhibit?
B: Yes, the vintage portraits are considered ___ the essence of post-war society beautifully.
options: A. to be captured
B. to capture
C. capturing
D. having captured
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：are considered 後方接 to V。肖像畫「捕捉」(capture) 社會本質是主動的動作，用 to capture 即可。選項 B 正確。

normal.desc:
【短文】Art Today: The local museum has been hosting a retrospective of the late painter's work. The early sketches are believed to have been heavily influenced by Japanese woodblock prints. The artist must have studied abroad during his formative years.
Q: What influenced the painter's early sketches?
options: A. The local museum
B. Japanese woodblock prints
C. His later paintings
D. European sculptures
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到「The early sketches are believed to have been heavily influenced by Japanese woodblock prints (早期素描被認為深受日本木版畫影響)」。選項 B 完全符合。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The exhibition successfully blends interactive media with traditional ___ to create a unique sensory experience.
options: A. aesthetics
B. consolidation
C. motives
D. exoplanets
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：aesthetics 意為「美學、審美觀」。句意為「展覽成功將互動媒體與傳統美學結合，創造獨特的感官體驗」。其他選項皆與藝術展覽語境不符。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

normal.explain: 英文：Eligible staff members have been receiving generous maternity benefits. 意思：符合資格的員工一直有收到豐厚的產假福利。eligible 為符合資格的，使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

options: A. 健康檢查的費用將由公司全額負擔。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

normal.explain: 英文：Your travel costs are currently being evaluated by the finance division. 意思：你的差旅費用目前正在由財務部門評估中。are being evaluated 為現在進行被動語態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

normal.explain: 英文：We have been reviewing the annual leave entitlements for all regional branches. 意思：我們一直在審查所有各地分公司的特休假資格（權益）。

normal.explain: 英文：He must have misunderstood the new overtime compensation policy. 意思：他一定是誤解了新的加班補償政策。must have misunderstood 表達對過去事件的推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

D. 你應該盡快去修理破損的擋風玻璃。

normal.explain: 英文：The original manuscript must have been edited heavily before publication. 意思：最初的手稿在出版前一定被大幅修改過。manuscript 為手稿。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: This particular anecdote is meant to be interpreted as a subtle warning.
options: A. 這首詩歌描述了作者對童年時光的回憶。

normal.explain: 英文：Historians have been piecing together the chronological events of that era. 意思：歷史學家們一直試圖拼湊出那個時代按時間順序發生的事件。chronological 為按時間順序的。

C. to cause

B. will overlook
C. can overlook

B. surge
C. alleviate
D. venture

B. By securing long-term contracts

C. scalable
D. sedentary

C. alleviated
D. alleviating
normal.explain: is proven 後接不定詞，表示對過去事實的證明用 to have + V-en。

D. experience

options: A. Caffeine consumption
B. Cognitive functions
C. A lack of deep sleep
D. Sleep cycles

normal.explain: 原句：They must have acquired a majority stake to force the hostile takeover.（他們一定取得了多數股權以強行進行惡意併購。）回應「對，董事會別無選擇只能順從」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Several prominent subsidiaries are going to be integrated into the parent company.
options: A. 幾家知名的子公司即將被整合進母公司中。
B. 母公司一直在剝離那些不賺錢的子公司。
C. 這些子公司一定拒絕了母公司的整合計畫。
D. 母公司必須在年底前收購更多的子公司。
normal.explain: 原句：Several prominent subsidiaries are going to be integrated into the parent company. 意思是「幾家知名的子公司即將被整合進母公司」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The multinational conglomerate has been expanding its influence in the tech sector.
options: A. 這個跨國集團一直在擴展其在科技領域的影響力。
B. 這個科技集團即將被一家跨國企業收購。
C. 跨國集團一定在科技領域遭遇了重大挫折。
D. 我們必須減少這個集團在市場上的影響力。
normal.explain: 原句：The multinational conglomerate has been expanding its influence in the tech sector. 意思是「這家跨國企業集團一直在擴展其於科技領域的影響力」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The merger agreement must have been scrutinized for potential antitrust violations.
options: A. 該合併協議一定因潛在的違反反托拉斯法而被仔細審查了。
B. 我們一直在審查合併協議以避免法律糾紛。
C. 這個協議正因為壟斷市場的嫌疑而被政府拒絕。
D. 他們必須修改協議以符合反壟斷法規。
normal.explain: 原句：The merger agreement must have been scrutinized for potential antitrust violations. 意思是「合併協議一定因潛在的反托拉斯（反壟斷）違規而被仔細審查過了」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: How long have the regulators been investigating this monopolistic behavior?
options: A. The behavior is being corrected immediately.
B. They must have discovered the monopoly yesterday.
C. For at least six months, and they are preparing a massive fine.
D. The investigation was undoubtedly successful.
normal.explain: 原句：How long have the regulators been investigating this monopolistic behavior?（監管機構調查這種壟斷行為多久了？）回應「至少六個月了，他們正在準備祭出鉅額罰款」符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The core curriculum is being redesigned to foster critical thinking skills.
options: A. 核心課綱正被重新設計以培養批判性思考能力。
B. 學校一直在尋找能教導批判性思考的老師。
C. 舊的課綱一定是阻礙了學生的思考發展。
D. 學生必須在核心課程中展現批判性思考。
normal.explain: 原句：The core curriculum is being redesigned to foster critical thinking skills. 意思是「核心課程正在被重新設計，以培養批判性思考技能」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The parents have been expressing concerns regarding the excessive extracurricular activities.
options: A. 家長們一直對過多的課外活動表達擔憂。
B. 課外活動即將因為家長的抗議而被取消。
C. 家長一定認為課外活動對學生的幫助不大。
D. 我們必須為學生安排更多有意義的活動。
normal.explain: 原句：The parents have been expressing concerns regarding the excessive extracurricular activities. 意思是「家長們一直對過度/過多的課外活動表達擔憂」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The disciplinary actions must have been implemented without consulting the student council.
options: A. 這些紀律處分一定是在沒有諮詢學生會的情況下實施的。
B. 學生會一直在要求學校撤銷這些懲處。
C. 學校即將實施一連串新的紀律處分方案。
D. 你必須在諮詢學生會之後才能採取懲處行動。
normal.explain: 原句：The disciplinary actions must have been implemented without consulting the student council. 意思是「這些懲處行動一定是在沒有諮詢學生會的情況下被執行的」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has the school been addressing the cyberbullying issues effectively?
options: A. The bullies must have been expelled immediately.
B. Yes, a strict zero-tolerance policy is being enforced now.
C. The internet connection is being repaired.
D. They have been organizing the annual sports day.
normal.explain: 原句：Has the school been addressing the cyberbullying issues effectively?（學校有一直在有效處理網路霸凌問題嗎？）回應「有，現在正在執行嚴格的零容忍政策」最切題。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A holistic approach to education is being promoted by the principal.
options: A. 校長正在推廣全人教育的理念。
B. 校長一定是改變了教育的方針。
C. 我們一直遵循校長提倡的教育方法。
D. 這種教育方式必須被全面推廣到所有學校。
normal.explain: 原句：A holistic approach to education is being promoted by the principal. 意思是「一種全人的教育方法正被校長推廣」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The fundraiser proceeds are going to be allocated to upgrade the science laboratory.
options: A. 募款活動的收益將被分配用來升級科學實驗室。
B. 我們一直在為了升級科學實驗室而進行募款。
C. 實驗室的設備一定是用上次的募款買的。
D. 學校必須舉辦募款活動才能維持實驗室運作。
normal.explain: 原句：The fundraiser proceeds are going to be allocated to upgrade the science laboratory. 意思是「募款收益將被分配用來升級科學實驗室」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: We have been advocating for a more inclusive learning environment for students with disabilities.
options: A. The environment must have been polluted recently.
B. That's great, equal access to education is crucial.
C. The disabled students are being expelled.
D. You must have forgotten to include the attachments.
normal.explain: 原句：We have been advocating for a more inclusive learning environment for students with disabilities.（我們一直在為身障學生倡導一個更具包容性的學習環境。）回應「太好了，平等的受教權至關重要」最得體。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The adolescent upbringing issues must have been discussed during the PTA meeting.
options: A. 青少年的教養問題一定在家長會上被討論過了。
B. 家長們一直在家長會上爭論教養問題。
C. 教養問題正被學校專家詳細分析中。
D. 你必須在家長會上提出關於青少年教養的疑問。
normal.explain: 原句：The adolescent upbringing issues must have been discussed during the PTA meeting. 意思是「青少年教養問題一定在這次的家長教師聯誼會 (PTA) 上被討論過了」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Specialized workshops are being organized to assist parents in guiding their children.
options: A. 專門的工作坊正在被組織起來，以協助家長引導孩子。
B. 學校一直定期舉辦工作坊來教育家長。
C. 家長們一定覺得這些工作坊非常有幫助。
D. 你必須參加這些專門的工作坊才能了解孩子。
normal.explain: 原句：Specialized workshops are being organized to assist parents in guiding their children. 意思是「專門的工作坊正被籌辦中，以協助父母引導他們的孩子」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The outdated grading system has been negatively impacting student motivation.
options: A. 過時的評分系統一直對學生的動機產生負面影響。
B. 學生的動機一定是因為評分不公而下降。
C. 評分系統即將被全新的機制所取代。
D. 我們必須改變這種會影響學生動機的評分方式。
normal.explain: 原句：The outdated grading system has been negatively impacting student motivation. 意思是「過時的評分系統一直對學生的動機產生負面影響」。

normal.desc: 【時態】The committee ___ the transition to renewable energy for several months.
options: A. is facilitating
B. has been facilitating
C. will facilitate
D. facilitates
normal.explain: 句末有 for several months，強調動作從過去一直持續到現在，必須使用現在完成進行式 (have/has been V-ing)。其他選項時態不符。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The solar farm project is expected ___ by a sudden drop in component prices.
options: A. to accelerate
B. to be accelerated
C. accelerating
D. accelerated
normal.explain: expect 後接不定詞 (to V)，而專案是被加速的，因此需要被動語態 (to be V-en)。選項 B 最符合文法與語意。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The power grid failed again. The engineering team ___ the maintenance warnings.
options: A. should overlook
B. will overlook
C. must have overlooked
D. can overlook
normal.explain: 對於過去發生的事實（電網故障）進行強烈推測，表示「當時必定是...」，應使用 must have V-en。選項 C 為正確答案。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Has the wind turbine installation finished?
B: No, they ___ the structural integrity since yesterday due to the severe storm.
options: A. assess
B. are assessing
C. have been assessing
D. will assess
normal.explain: 由 since yesterday 可知動作從昨天持續至今仍在進行，因此須使用現在完成進行式。選項 C 最合適。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did the offshore project fail?
B: The environmental impact is proven ___ severely underestimated by the developers.
options: A. to have been
B. to be
C. being
D. have been
normal.explain: 「被證實」是現在的狀態 (is proven)，而「被低估」是發生在過去的事情，不定詞需用完成式被動 (to have been V-en) 來表達時間的先後順序。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To achieve carbon neutrality, the nation must drastically reduce its ___ on fossil fuels.
options: A. reliance
B. resilient
C. relevant
D. reluctant
normal.explain: 空格處需要名詞作受詞。reliance 意為「依賴」，符合句意（減少對化石燃料的依賴）。其他選項均為形容詞或字義不合。

normal.desc:
【短文】Energy Report: The transition to green hydrogen has been gaining momentum. The initial extraction process is confirmed to have been optimized by a new catalyst. The leading scientists must have collaborated extensively with chemical engineers to achieve this breakthrough.
Q: What helped optimize the extraction process?
options: A. A new catalyst
B. Green hydrogen
C. The energy report
D. Fossil fuels
normal.explain: 短文中提到「The initial extraction process is confirmed to have been optimized by a new catalyst.」，直接指出是新的催化劑優化了萃取過程。

normal.desc: 【時態】Educational authorities ___ the national curriculum to better reflect modern technological skills.
options: A. have been overhauling
B. overhaul
C. are overhauled
D. overhauling
normal.explain: 句意表示教育當局一段時間以來持續在翻新課程，以反映現代技能，用現在完成進行式最符合語境。C為被動語意不對，D缺乏助動詞。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The traditional grading system is considered ___ obsolete by many progressive educators.
options: A. to have become
B. becoming
C. became
D. has become
normal.explain: is considered 後面接不定詞，表示「被認為已經變得過時」，強調整個轉變在過去已經發生，因此用 to have become 最自然。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The students struggled with the exam. The teacher ___ the complex theories too briefly.
options: A. could cover
B. must have covered
C. is covering
D. will cover
normal.explain: 學生考試考得很掙扎是過去的事實，據此強烈推斷老師當時一定講得太簡略，使用 must have V-en 最合適。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How are the teachers reacting to the new pedagogical guidelines?
B: They ___ their lesson plans to align with the framework all week.
options: A. modify
B. have been modifying
C. modified
D. are modified
normal.explain: 關鍵字 all week 表示整個星期都在持續做某事，必須搭配現在完成進行式 (have been modifying)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did they abolish the standardized test?
B: Yes, the assessment method is determined ___ highly biased against marginalized groups.
options: A. to be
B. to have
C. being
D. is
normal.explain: is determined 後方接 to be + 形容詞 (highly biased)，表示「被判定為...」，符合英文句型習慣。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The university aims to foster an inclusive environment that promotes intellectual ___ among its diverse student body.
options: A. discourse
B. disease
C. disconnect
D. discard
normal.explain: intellectual discourse 意為「學術交流、知識對話」，符合大學促進多元學生交流的語境。其他選項皆不合理。

normal.desc:
【短文】Educational Insight: Schools in the district have been experimenting with flipped classrooms. The shift in teaching dynamics is shown to have improved student engagement significantly. The administration must have invested heavily in digital infrastructure to make this possible.
Q: What is the main benefit of the flipped classroom mentioned?
options: A. Reduced administrative workload
B. Improved student engagement
C. Cheaper digital infrastructure
D. Shorter teaching hours
normal.explain: 短文中明確指出「is shown to have improved student engagement significantly」，故 B 為正確答案。

normal.desc: 【時態】The hospitality group ___ guest complaints regarding the outdated plumbing for months.
options: A. monitors
B. has been monitoring
C. is monitored
D. will monitor
normal.explain: for months 點出時間的持續性，需使用現在完成進行式。句子為主動，飯店集團持續監控客訴。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The complimentary breakfast buffet is reported ___ drastically downgraded since the new management took over.
options: A. to downgrade
B. downgrading
C. to have been
D. has been
normal.explain: is reported 後接不定詞。因為自助餐是「被降級」，且動作從過去新管理層接手就已經發生，需用 to have been + V-en 結構。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The guest room was freezing upon arrival. The housekeeping staff ___ to turn on the heating system.
options: A. must have forgotten
B. should forget
C. will forget
D. can forget
normal.explain: 房間很冷是過去的事實，推測當時房務人員必定是忘記開暖氣，用 must have + V-en 表達過去的強烈推論。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Are they still investigating the data breach in the reservation system?
B: Yes, the IT team ___ the server logs non-stop since Sunday.
options: A. scan
B. scanned
C. is scanning
D. has been scanning
normal.explain: 關鍵字 since Sunday 加上 non-stop，表示動作從週日持續至今且不斷進行，必須使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why was the resort's rating penalized?
B: The poor hygiene standards in the spa area are found ___ multiple health code violations.
options: A. to have caused
B. to cause
C. causing
D. cause
normal.explain: 「被發現 (are found)」是現在，而「造成違規」是之前發生的事。因此要用 to have + V-en 表達先發生的主動動作。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To enhance guest satisfaction, the hotel decided to ___ its loyalty program with more personalized rewards.
options: A. revamp
B. revolve
C. revolt
D. reveal
normal.explain: revamp 意為「翻新、修改」，符合更新忠誠度計畫的語境。revolve 為旋轉，revolt 為反叛，reveal 為揭露。

normal.desc:
【短文】Guest Review: My family has been staying at this resort for a decade. Unfortunately, the quality of the room service is perceived to have plummeted this year. The chef must have drastically altered the menu without testing the new recipes.
Q: What issue did the guest experience?
options: A. The room was too small
B. A drop in room service quality
C. The resort was relocated
D. The menu was too expensive
normal.explain: 文章提到「the quality of the room service is perceived to have plummeted (直線下降)」，選項 B 與此意相符。

normal.desc: 【時態】The legal representatives ___ a potential compromise out of court for the past forty-eight hours.
options: A. have been seeking
B. seeks
C. are sought
D. has sought
normal.explain: for the past forty-eight hours 提示動作持續發生，主詞為複數 (representatives)，需用 have been seeking。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The core algorithm is alleged ___ from an open-source repository without proper attribution.
options: A. to copy
B. copying
C. to have been copied
D. copied
normal.explain: is alleged 後接不定詞。演算法是「被抄襲」，且抄襲發生在過去，因此使用完成式被動 to have been copied。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The competitor released an identical smartwatch. They ___ access to our confidential design schematics.
options: A. must have gained
B. should gain
C. will gain
D. have gained
normal.explain: 對手發布一模一樣的產品是已發生的事實，由此推斷對手「當時一定取得了」我們的機密設計圖，故用 must have V-en。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How long has the litigation been going on?
B: The two software giants ___ over intellectual property rights for nearly three years.
options: A. are fighting
B. have been fighting
C. fought
D. fight
normal.explain: for nearly three years 表達持續了一段時間並延續至今的狀態，因此使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the judge grant the injunction?
B: Yes, the defendant is ordered ___ the distribution of the disputed software immediately.
options: A. to halt
B. halting
C. halted
D. halt
normal.explain: be ordered to do something 是固定句型，表示「被命令去做某事」，halt 意為「停止」，此處為主動動作。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The startup filed a lawsuit claiming that the tech giant's new feature was a blatant ___ of their registered patent.
options: A. infringement
B. inflation
C. infection
D. influx
normal.explain: infringement 意為「侵犯、侵害」，常與專利 (patent) 或版權搭配使用。其他選項皆不符合語境。

normal.desc:
【短文】Tech Legal Brief: The semiconductor company has been fiercely defending its patents. The unauthorized use of their microarchitecture is proven to have inflicted massive financial damage. The rival manufacturer must have reverse-engineered the chip despite the strict non-disclosure agreements.
Q: What is the rival manufacturer accused of doing?
options: A. Signing new agreements
B. Reverse-engineering the chip
C. Selling the company
D. Fixing financial damage
normal.explain: 文中提到「The rival manufacturer must have reverse-engineered the chip (競爭對手必定是逆向工程了該晶片)」，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【時態】The city planners ___ the dilapidated waterfront district since the beginning of the mayor's term.
options: A. have been revitalizing
B. revitalize
C. are revitalized
D. will revitalize
normal.explain: 句中的 since 標示動作從過去市長上任之初開始，一直持續到現在，因此需用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The abandoned industrial complex is slated ___ into an eco-friendly residential hub by next spring.
options: A. to transform
B. to be transformed
C. transforming
D. transformed
normal.explain: be slated to do something 意指「預定要...」，而工業區是「被改造」，所以要使用不定詞的被動式 (to be transformed)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The historic theater was demolished overnight. The municipal council ___ the preservation orders completely.
options: A. must have bypassed
B. could bypass
C. will bypass
D. should bypass
normal.explain: 歷史劇院在一夜之間被拆除，這是已發生的事實。推論市議會「必定是忽視/繞過了」保護令，應使用 must have V-en。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the road construction taking so long?
B: They ___ the archaic underground sewage pipes for the past six months.
options: A. excavate
B. have been excavating
C. are excavated
D. excavated
normal.explain: for the past six months 表示這六個月以來持續不斷的動作，故以現在完成進行式表達最為準確。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is the new zoning law finalized?
B: Yes, the commercial district is expected ___ by lush green spaces to improve air quality.
options: A. to surround
B. surrounding
C. to be surrounded
D. surrounds
normal.explain: 商業區是「被綠地環繞」，且在 is expected 後面，須使用不定詞的被動態 (to be surrounded)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The rapid ___ of the downtown area has forced many low-income families to relocate due to soaring rents.
options: A. gentrification
B. generation
C. gesture
D. globalization
normal.explain: gentrification 指的是「士紳化、中產階級化」，通常伴隨租金上漲、低收入戶被迫搬遷的現象，完全符合句意。

normal.desc:
【短文】City Planning Gazette: The council has been promoting the creation of pedestrian-only zones. The reduction in vehicular traffic is observed to have significantly lowered local air pollution levels. The shop owners, who initially opposed the plan, must have realized that foot traffic actually boosts retail sales.
Q: What did shop owners realize?
options: A. Cars bring more customers
B. Foot traffic increases sales
C. Air pollution affects products
D. The council will raise taxes
normal.explain: 文末提到「must have realized that foot traffic actually boosts retail sales (必定是意識到步行人潮其實能提升零售業績)」，選 B。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To prevent flooding during the monsoon season, the city must improve the ___ of its drainage infrastructure.
options: A. capacity
B. captive
C. capsule
D. capital

normal.explain: 「The research team has been analyzing the preliminary data sets for several months.」意思是「研究團隊幾個月來一直在分析初步資料集。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The empirical findings are expected to be published in a peer-reviewed journal.
options: A. 這些實證結果一定已經發表在同儕審查的期刊上了。
B. 我們一直在同儕審查的期刊上發表這些實證結果。
C. 這些實證結果必須立刻投稿到同儕審查的期刊。
D. 這些實證結果預計將發表在同儕審查的期刊上。
normal.explain: 「The empirical findings are expected to be published in a peer-reviewed journal.」意思是「這些實證結果預計將發表在同儕審查的期刊上。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: You must have isolated the independent variable incorrectly during the experiment.
options: A. Let me recheck the setup and run the trial again.
B. The laboratory is being thoroughly cleaned right now.
C. We have been waiting for the final results.
D. The variables are expected to be analyzed tomorrow.
normal.explain: 說話者推測：「You must have isolated the independent variable incorrectly during the experiment.（你在實驗過程中一定錯誤地分離了自變數。）」最合理的回應是打算重新檢查並再次實驗 (A)。（重點文法：must have done）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been refining our central hypothesis based on the recent qualitative observations.
options: A. 我們的核心假說預計將根據近期的質性觀察進行修改。
B. 我們一直根據近期的質性觀察來完善我們的核心假說。
C. 我們的核心假說一定是因為近期的質性觀察而失敗了。
D. 我們必須立刻根據近期的質性觀察放棄核心假說。
normal.explain: 「We have been refining our central hypothesis based on the recent qualitative observations.」意思是「我們一直根據近期的質性觀察來完善我們的核心假說。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Is the control group being monitored for any unexpected behavioral changes?
options: A. The control group must have completed the survey.
B. We have been studying their genetic makeup.
C. Yes, we are observing them around the clock.
D. The expected changes are not going to be recorded.
normal.explain: 說話者詢問：「Is the control group being monitored for any unexpected behavioral changes?（對照組是否正受到監控以觀察任何意外的行為變化？）」最合理的回應是肯定並表示24小時都在觀察 (C)。（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The sudden temperature drop must have skewed the final chemical analysis.
options: A. 溫度的突然下降目前正在影響最終的化學分析。
B. 我們一直在調查溫度突然下降對化學分析的影響。
C. 化學分析預計會因為溫度的突然下降而延遲。
D. 溫度的突然下降一定使得最終的化學分析出現偏差。
normal.explain: 「The sudden temperature drop must have skewed the final chemical analysis.」意思是「溫度的突然下降一定使得最終的化學分析出現偏差。」（重點文法：must have done）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Our department has been collaborating with international scholars to broaden the scope.
options: A. 為了擴展領域，我們部門一直在與國際學者合作。
B. 我們的部門一定已經與國際學者完成了合作。
C. 為了擴展領域，我們的部門預計會被國際學者接管。
D. 我們的部門必須停止與國際學者的跨領域合作。
normal.explain: 「Our department has been collaborating with international scholars to broaden the scope.」意思是「為了擴展領域，我們部門一直在與國際學者合作。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The theoretical models are currently being validated through rigorous empirical testing.
options: A. 理論模型一定已經通過了嚴格的實證測試。
B. 理論模型目前正透過嚴格的實證測試進行驗證。
C. 我們一直在理論模型中尋找實證測試的錯誤。
D. 理論模型預計將在沒有實證測試的情況下被發布。
normal.explain: 「The theoretical models are currently being validated through rigorous empirical testing.」意思是「理論模型目前正透過嚴格的實證測試進行驗證。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The alarm system has been flashing continuously since the power outage began.
options: A. 自從停電開始，警報系統就一直在持續閃爍。
B. 警報系統一定是因為停電才被燒壞的。
C. 警報系統預計在停電結束後就會恢復閃爍。
D. 自從停電開始，我們必須手動關閉警報系統。
normal.explain: 「The alarm system has been flashing continuously since the power outage began.」意思是「自從停電開始，警報系統就一直在持續閃爍。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: All personnel are strictly required to be escorted to the designated assembly area.
options: A. 所有人員一定已經在指定的集合地點會合了。
B. 嚴格要求所有人員必須被護送到指定的集合區域。
C. 救護人員一直在將傷者護送到指定的集合區域。
D. 所有人員都必須自行前往指定的集合區域報到。
normal.explain: 「All personnel are strictly required to be escorted to the designated assembly area.」意思是「嚴格要求所有人員必須被護送到指定的集合區域。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Someone must have triggered the fire alarm accidentally on the third floor.
options: A. The fire alarm has been ringing all morning.
B. The evacuation protocol is being updated today.
C. I hope it's just a false alarm and no one is hurt.
D. You must have extinguished the fire yourself.
normal.explain: 說話者推測：「Someone must have triggered the fire alarm accidentally on the third floor.（一定有人在三樓不小心觸發了火災警報。）」最合理的回應是希望只是誤報且無人受傷 (C)。（重點文法：must have done）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been clearing hazardous materials from the primary escape routes.
options: A. 主要逃生路線上的危險物質一定已經被清除了。
B. 這些危險物質預計將被放置在主要逃生路線上。
C. 我們必須立刻封鎖主要逃生路線上的危險物質。
D. 我們一直在清理主要逃生路線上的危險物質。
normal.explain: 「We have been clearing hazardous materials from the primary escape routes.」意思是「我們一直在清理主要逃生路線上的危險物質。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Are the emergency doors being unlocked by the security personnel right now?
options: A. Yes, they are clearing all the main exits as we speak.
B. The security personnel have been waiting outside.
C. Someone must have locked the doors by mistake.
D. The doors are designed to be permanently locked.
normal.explain: 說話者詢問：「Are the emergency doors being unlocked by the security personnel right now?（保全人員現在正在解鎖緊急逃生門嗎？）」最合理的回應是肯定並說明他們正在淨空出口 (A)。（重點文法：複雜被動）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The ventilation system must have shut down automatically to contain the smoke.
options: A. 通風系統一直在自動運作以排出室內的濃煙。
B. 通風系統一定為了控制煙霧而自動關閉了。
C. 為了控制煙霧，通風系統預計會被遠端關閉。
D. 我們必須手動關閉通風系統來防止煙霧擴散。
normal.explain: 「The ventilation system must have shut down automatically to contain the smoke.」意思是「通風系統一定為了控制煙霧而自動關閉了。」（重點文法：must have done）

normal.desc: 【時態】The financial analysts ___ consumer behavior continuously since the new tariff was announced.
options: A. have been monitoring
B. will be monitoring
C. are monitored
D. had monitored
normal.explain: 本題測試現在完成進行式。句尾有 since 帶出的一段時間，且強調動作持續至今，故選 have been V-ing。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The recent surge in commodity prices is believed ___ by global supply chain disruptions.
options: A. trigger
B. to have been triggered
C. triggering
D. to trigger
normal.explain: 本題測試複雜被動語態。主詞是價格飆升，被認為「已經被」引發，故使用 is believed to have been + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The rival brand launched an identical campaign overnight; they ___ our leaked marketing strategy.
options: A. should copy
B. can copy
C. must have copied
D. will have copied
normal.explain: 本題測試對過去事實的強烈推測。對手一夜之間推出相同活動，推測他們「必定已經」抄襲了我們的策略，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To boost online sales, the marketing team needs to offer a compelling ___ for first-time buyers.
options: A. deterrent
B. saturation
C. disparity
D. incentive
normal.explain: incentive (動機/誘因) 符合句意「提供強大的誘因給首次購買者」。deterrent (威懾物)、saturation (飽和)、disparity (差距) 皆不合。

normal.desc: 【時態】The HR department ___ the updated employee handbook to include the new remote work policies for weeks.
options: A. is revised
B. has been revising
C. will revise
D. having revised
normal.explain: for weeks 表示持續一段時間到現在的動作，使用現在完成進行式 has been revising。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Attendance at the annual compliance training is considered ___ compulsory for all full-time staff.
options: A. to be
B. been
C. being
D. was
normal.explain: consider 的被動語法為 be considered to be + 補語（或直接加補語）。此處選 to be 最為完整合理。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The server crashed right after the new update was installed. The IT team ___ some incompatible codes.
options: A. must have deployed
B. would deploy
C. ought to deploy
D. can deploy
normal.explain: 對於過去發生的伺服器崩潰原因進行強烈推測，表示「必定已經部署了」不相容的程式碼，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The strict dress code policy has been heavily criticized for being a ___ to creative expression in the workplace.
options: A. leverage
B. deterrent
C. exemption
D. resilience
normal.explain: deterrent 意為「阻礙物/威懾物」，符合「對職場創意表現造成阻礙」的語意。

normal.desc: 【時態】The marine biologists ___ the migration patterns of these endangered whales for over a decade.
options: A. have been tracking
B. track
C. are tracked
D. will track
normal.explain: for over a decade 搭配現在完成進行式，表示動作從過去持續到現在。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The newly discovered fossil is hypothesized ___ to the late Jurassic period by leading paleontologists.
options: A. belonging
B. belong
C. to belong
D. belonged
normal.explain: be hypothesized to + 原形動詞，表示「被假定為...」。因此選 to belong。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The lab rats navigated the complex maze flawlessly. They ___ the route during the previous trials.
options: A. could memorize
B. must have memorized
C. will memorize
D. are memorizing
normal.explain: 完美走完迷宮是過去事實，推測其原因「必定是已經記住了路線」，故選 must have memorized。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The latest breakthrough in genome editing is expected to completely ___ the field of hereditary diseases.
options: A. deteriorate
B. alleviate
C. dismantle
D. revolutionize
normal.explain: revolutionize (徹底改變/使革命化) 符合重大科學突破對疾病領域的影響。alleviate 是減輕，不搭配 the field。

normal.desc: 【時態】The tourism board ___ a sustainable travel initiative to reduce the carbon footprint of foreign visitors.
options: A. has been promoting
B. is promoted
C. will be promoted
D. having promoted
normal.explain: 主動語態且表示近期持續進行的動作，選現在完成進行式 has been promoting。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The influx of tourists is observed ___ a disproportionate strain on the island's limited water resources.
options: A. placed
B. to have placed
C. place
D. placing
normal.explain: is observed to have + p.p. 表示「被觀察到已經...」，符合對已發生事實的被動描述。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The historic monument was severely defaced overnight. The vandals ___ the lax security patrols.
options: A. should exploit
B. might exploit
C. must have exploited
D. will have exploited
normal.explain: 古蹟被破壞是已發生的事，推論破壞者「必定利用了」鬆散的保全巡邏，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To prevent the local culture from being eroded, the government must impose strict ___ on commercial development.
options: A. incentives
B. disparities
C. exemptions
D. constraints
normal.explain: constraints 意為「限制/約束」，符合政府對商業開發實施嚴格限制以保護當地文化的語境。

normal.desc: 【時態】The non-profit organization ___ emergency relief supplies to the drought-stricken regions for three consecutive months.
options: A. has been dispatching
B. dispatched
C. is dispatched
D. to dispatch
normal.explain: for three consecutive months 強調動作持續至今，故選 has been dispatching。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The community outreach program is reported ___ successfully in bridging the wealth gap in urban areas.
options: A. implemented
B. to have been implemented
C. implement
D. is implementing
normal.explain: is reported to have been + p.p. 表示「據報導已經被實施」，符合複雜被動語態的結構。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The charity raised an unprecedented amount of funds. The celebrity endorsement ___ a significant impact.
options: A. must have made
B. ought to make
C. could make
D. will make
normal.explain: 推測名人代言必定在過去產生了重大影響，使用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The NGO's primary ___ this year is to provide clean drinking water to over fifty remote villages.
options: A. saturation
B. endeavor
C. disparity
D. leverage
normal.explain: endeavor (努力/事業/目標) 符合句意「今年主要的努力目標是...」。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you reviewed the latest market saturation report?
B: Yes, our profit margins are proven ___ steadily by the fierce price wars since last quarter.
options: A. shrinking
B. to have been shrinking
C. shrink
D. shrunk
normal.explain: are proven to have been V-ing 表示「被證實一直都在...」，符合 since last quarter 強調持續狀態的語境。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why didn't the marketing team launch the campaign on time?
B: They ___ a lot of internal resistance regarding the budget allocation.
options: A. must have faced
B. should face
C. can face
D. will have faced
normal.explain: 解釋過去沒有準時推出的原因，推測「必定是面臨了內部阻力」，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【句子】The board of directors ___ the feasibility of expanding into the Southeast Asian market, but they remain skeptical about the infrastructure.
options: A. are evaluating
B. to evaluate
C. have been evaluating
D. evaluates
normal.explain: 強調這段時間以來持續評估的動作，使用現在完成進行式 have been evaluating。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the staff read the new remote work policy in the handbook?
B: Probably not. The HR department is alleged ___ the notification email to the wrong mailing list.
options: A. sent
B. sending
C. to be sent
D. to have sent
normal.explain: is alleged to have + p.p. 表示「據稱已經做了...」，符合句意「據稱人資把信寄錯了名單」。

normal.desc: 【句子】Many employees missed the mandatory compliance seminar. They ___ the reminder that was buried at the bottom of the weekly newsletter.
options: A. must have overlooked
B. will overlook
C. could overlook
D. should overlook
normal.explain: 推測員工「必定是忽略了」藏在電子報底部的提醒，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What is the latest finding from the genome lab?
B: The researchers ___ a specific protein that can potentially reverse cellular aging.
options: A. are isolated
B. have been isolating
C. to isolate
D. isolate
normal.explain: 表示研究人員最近一直持續在分離特定蛋白質，用現在完成進行式 have been isolating 最適當。

normal.desc: 【句子】The sudden reduction in greenhouse gases during the lockdown is considered ___ a temporary phenomenon rather than a permanent climate shift.
options: A. be
B. to be
C. been
D. being
normal.explain: is considered to be... 為常見的被動語態結構，意指「被認為是...」。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have local businesses complained about the new eco-tax on plastics?
B: Yes, the retail sector ___ fiercely against the regulations for the past two months.
options: A. lobby
B. lobbied
C. has been lobbying
D. is lobbied
normal.explain: for the past two months 表示持續進行到現在，故選現在完成進行式 has been lobbying。

normal.desc: 【句子】The government's ambitious attempt to build a massive artificial reef is thought ___ significant damage to the existing coral ecosystems.
options: A. causing
B. cause
C. to have caused
D. caused
normal.explain: is thought to have caused... 意為「被認為已經造成了...」，表達對過去已發生之事的被動看法。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did the NGO lose its primary corporate sponsor?
B: The board of directors ___ the charity's financial transparency reports during the recent audit.
options: A. can scrutinize
B. must have scrutinized
C. will scrutinize
D. are scrutinizing
normal.explain: 推測贊助商撤資的原因，必定是董事會在審計期間仔細審查了財務透明度報告，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc:
【短文】Market Analysis Brief: We have been tracking the consumer response to our newly launched vegan snack line. The initial sales figures are reported to have exceeded all quarterly projections by 40%. The marketing department must have leveraged the social media influencers exceptionally well. 
Q: What is true about the marketing department?
options: A. They ignored social media trends.
B. They failed to meet quarterly projections.
C. They are believed to have used influencers effectively.
D. They changed the product's vegan ingredients.
normal.explain: 文中提到 The marketing department must have leveraged the social media influencers exceptionally well，推論他們非常有效地利用了網紅行銷。

normal.desc:
【短文】HR Memo: The management has been reviewing the employee retention rates across all branches. The sudden spike in resignations in the IT department is hypothesized to have been caused by the mandatory overtime policy. The department heads must have underestimated the staff's burnout levels. 
Q: What did the department heads likely underestimate?
options: A. The company's profit margin.
B. The effectiveness of the new software.
C. The employees' exhaustion from overwork.
D. The number of new applicants.
normal.explain: 文中提到 must have underestimated the staff's burnout levels (必定低估了員工的倦怠程度)，選項 C 的 exhaustion from overwork 是同義替換。

normal.desc:
【短文】Science Journal Press Release: Researchers have been observing the impact of microplastics on marine life. The accumulation of toxins in local fish populations is confirmed to have reached unprecedented levels. Regulatory bodies must have ignored previous environmental warnings for years to let this happen. 
Q: Why did the toxins reach unprecedented levels according to the passage?
options: A. Regulatory bodies likely ignored past warnings.
B. The researchers fabricated the data.
C. Fish populations naturally evolved to absorb more toxins.
D. A new type of plastic was recently invented.
normal.explain: 文中提到 Regulatory bodies must have ignored previous environmental warnings for years，因此選 A。

normal.desc:
【短文】Tourism Policy Review: The city council has been attempting to limit the number of daily visitors to the historical district. The excessive foot traffic is proven to have accelerated the deterioration of the cobblestone streets. Local shop owners, seeing reduced sales, must have panicked and petitioned against the visitor cap. 
Q: What is a consequence of excessive foot traffic mentioned in the text?
options: A. An increase in local sales.
B. The destruction of the historical streets.
C. A surge in new shop openings.
D. Improved maintenance of the cobblestones.
normal.explain: 文中提到 excessive foot traffic is proven to have accelerated the deterioration of the cobblestone streets (加速了石板路的惡化)，即破壞歷史街道。

normal.desc:
【短文】NGO Annual Report: Over the past year, we have been vigorously advocating for refugee rights at the borders. The harsh immigration policies are known to have separated thousands of families unjustly. The international community must have turned a blind eye to these human rights violations until the recent media coverage. 
Q: What is implied about the international community?
options: A. They provided immediate assistance to the refugees.
B. They actively created the harsh immigration policies.
C. They ignored the violations before the media reported them.
D. They funded the NGO's advocacy campaigns.
normal.explain: 文中提到 must have turned a blind eye to these human rights violations until the recent media coverage (在近期媒體報導前必定是視而不見)，故選 C。

normal.desc:
【短文】Market Pulse: Startups in the electric vehicle sector have been struggling to secure capital. The recent withdrawal of several major investors is thought to have triggered a domino effect. The venture capitalists must have perceived the battery supply chain constraints as too risky. 
Q: What was a major concern for the venture capitalists?
options: A. The lack of consumer demand for electric vehicles.
B. The risks associated with the battery supply chain.
C. The excessive government regulations on startups.
D. The sudden resignation of key startup founders.
normal.explain: 文中指出 The venture capitalists must have perceived the battery supply chain constraints as too risky，故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文】Employee Handbook Excerpt: The company has been updating its grievance procedures to ensure fairness. Any formal complaints filed are required to be handled with strict confidentiality by the HR ethics committee. Employees who felt marginalized in the past must have hesitated to report incidents due to fear of retaliation. 
Q: Why might some employees have not reported incidents previously?
options: A. They were unaware of the grievance procedures.
B. They resolved the issues informally.
