normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Our competitors have been offering much lower prices to attract our clients.
options: A. The price tag is missing from this item.
B. I am attracted to the beautiful scenery.
C. We are competing in a marathon next week.
D. We need to revise our promotional strategy then.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：我們的競爭對手一直提供低得多的價格來吸引我們的客戶。原句：Our competitors have been offering much lower prices to attract our clients. 選項 D「那我們需要修改我們的促銷策略了」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The proposed deadline is considered to be unrealistic by our production team.
options: A. 我們的生產團隊認為提議的截止日期不切實際。
B. 生產團隊已經同意將截止日期延後一週。
C. 專案經理向生產團隊提出了新的時間表。
D. 生產團隊認為這個提案將無法如期完成。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：我們的生產團隊認為提議的截止日期不切實際。原句：The proposed deadline is considered to be unrealistic by our production team.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: They must have rejected our initial offer without even reading the terms.
options: A. Reading books is a great hobby.
B. I agree; it was dismissed far too quickly.
C. The initial phase is complete now.
D. We rejected the flawed products.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：他們一定是連條款都沒看就拒絕了我們最初的報價。原句：They must have rejected our initial offer without even reading the terms. 選項 B「我同意；它被駁回得太快了」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been trying to break this deadlock since the morning session.
options: A. 我們從早上就在試圖打破這扇鎖上的門。
B. 早上的會議已經成功解決了所有爭議。
C. 我們從上午的會議開始就一直試圖打破這個僵局。
D. 雙方的談判代表決定在上午暫停會談。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：我們從上午的會議開始就一直試圖打破這個僵局。原句：We have been trying to break this deadlock since the morning session.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Significant concessions are expected to be made by both parties today.
options: A. I bought some snacks from the concession stand.
B. Let's party until the sun comes up.
C. The significance of this event cannot be denied.
D. Yes, otherwise we won't reach an agreement.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：預計今天雙方都會做出重大讓步。原句：Significant concessions are expected to be made by both parties today. 選項 D「對，否則我們將無法達成協議」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The foreign delegates must have been insulted by his aggressive tactics.
options: A. 外國代表一定對他咄咄逼人的策略感到被侮辱了。
B. 他強勢的手段成功說服了所有的外國代表。
C. 外國代表們拒絕使用如此具有攻擊性的戰術。
D. 他對於外國代表的無禮行為感到非常憤怒。
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：外國代表一定對他咄咄逼人的策略感到被侮辱了。原句：The foreign delegates must have been insulted by his aggressive tactics.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Your legal team has been pushing for a more lucrative compensation package.
options: A. The package was delivered to the front door.
B. We believe our expertise justifies the higher rate.
C. Pushing heavy objects can cause back injuries.
D. The legal department is located on the third floor.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：您的法務團隊一直在爭取更優渥（利潤豐厚）的薪酬方案。原句：Your legal team has been pushing for a more lucrative compensation package. 選項 B「我們相信我們的專業知識配得上更高的費率」最適合。

normal.desc: 【時態】The international trade commission ___ the impact of the new export tariffs on local agriculture for the past six months.
options: A. investigates
B. is investigated
C. has been investigating
D. will investigate
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句尾有「for the past six months」表示從過去一直持續到現在的動作，應使用現在完成進行式 (has been V-ing)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The psychological wellbeing of remote workers is proven ___ significantly by prolonged social isolation.
options: A. to have been damaged
B. has damaged
C. to damage
D. damaging
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此處使用「is proven to + 不定詞」，且動作發生在過去並有被動意味，因此使用完成被動不定詞 (to have been + p.p.)。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The architectural firm won the prestigious award. They ___ an incredibly sustainable urban layout.
options: A. should design
B. must have designed
C. could design
D. will have designed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：前句提到建築事務所贏得大獎，後句是對過去事實的強烈推測，應使用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The newly passed healthcare policy aims to provide a comprehensive ___ to low-income families seeking medical assistance.
options: A. penalty
B. subsidy
C. hindrance
D. diagnosis
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：subsidy 意為「補貼、津貼」，符合提供低收入戶醫療援助的語境。penalty 是罰款，hindrance 是阻礙。

normal.desc: 【時態】E-commerce platforms ___ stricter anti-counterfeit measures since the consumer protection laws were updated.
options: A. enforces
B. had enforced
C. have been enforcing
D. will be enforced
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：自從法律更新(since)以來，平台「一直持續」執行更嚴格的措施，需用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden increase in global shipping rates is generally considered ___ by severe port congestions.
options: A. to be caused
B. to have been caused
C. causing
D. having caused
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：「被認為是由於...所引起」，由於塞港是發生在運費上漲之前或同時的已經發生的事，用 to have been caused 最準確表達過去的被動原因。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The employee suddenly burst into tears during the performance review. The manager ___ some highly insensitive remarks.
options: A. must have made
B. should have made
C. might make
D. would make
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：對過去發生的事情（員工突然哭了）作強烈推測，經理「一定說了」不敏感的話，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The avant-garde building features a stunning glass ___, which maximizes natural light in the main lobby.
options: A. foundation
B. facade
C. basement
D. corridor
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：facade 指建築物的「正面、外牆」。玻璃外牆能最大化自然光，符合句意。

normal.desc: 【時態】Healthcare administrators ___ resources to emergency departments due to the unexpected flu outbreak.
options: A. redirect
B. have been redirecting
C. is redirected
D. redirects
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：表示從疫情爆發到現在「一直持續在重新分配」資源，用現在完成進行式最適當。

normal.desc: 【字彙】According to the updated terms of service, the e-commerce giant explicitly disclaims any ___ for third-party shipping delays.
options: A. liability
B. asset
C. prospect
D. momentum
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：disclaim liability 意為「免除責任」。電商巨頭聲明對第三方的運送延遲不承擔責任。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have the two countries reached a trade agreement yet?
B: Not at all. They ___ over the import quotas for agricultural products for several consecutive weeks.
options: A. are bargaining
B. have been bargaining
C. had bargained
D. will be bargaining
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：B 回答「好幾個連續星期」，表示談判動作從過去持續到現在，應使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why did the lead designer resign so abruptly?
B: The excessive micromanagement from the board is widely believed ___ her creative autonomy.
options: A. to have stifled
B. to stifle
C. stifling
D. has stifled
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：is widely believed to... 後接不定詞。因為「扼殺自主權」是發生在離職之前的動作，需用完成式不定詞 to have stifled。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the clinic receive the extra funding from the government?
B: Yes, the administrative team ___ tirelessly to secure that grant since last autumn.
options: A. works
B. is working
C. has been working
D. will have worked
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：「since last autumn」表明動作從去年秋天延續至今，故選現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【句子】Many online sellers found their accounts suspended overnight. They ___ the newly updated anti-fraud provisions without realizing it.
options: A. ought to violate
B. must have violated
C. are violating
D. will violate
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：帳號被停權是已發生的事實，推測他們「一定是在不知不覺中違反了」新規定，用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【句子】The persistent supply chain disruptions are projected to severely ___ the delivery timelines of the major electronic components.
options: A. expedite
B. alleviate
C. hamper
D. subsidize
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：供應鏈中斷預期會「阻礙 (hamper)」交貨時程。expedite 是加速，alleviate 是減輕，皆不合語意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is it true that the entire department is suffering from severe burnout?
B: Unfortunately, yes. The continuous restructuring ___ a highly toxic atmosphere in the workplace.
options: A. to create
B. creates
C. is believed to have created
D. having created
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句子缺乏主要動詞，C 選項是完整的被動語態與完成式不定詞組合「被認為已經造成了...」，符合句法與語意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: The new library complex looks completely different from the initial blueprints.
B: The architects ___ the design to adhere to the strict environmental regulations.
options: A. must have altered
B. should alter
C. will have altered
D. might be altering
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：看到完工的建築與藍圖不同，推測建築師「一定更改了」設計，使用 must have + p.p. 表示強烈推測。

normal.desc: 【句子】Due to the drastic shift in global trade policies, multinational corporations ___ their overseas investments for the past few quarters.
options: A. are scaling back
B. scale back
C. have been scaling back
D. will scale back
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：關鍵字為「for the past few quarters」，表示過去幾季以來一直持續的動作，需用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc:
【短文】Trade Journal: The government has been imposing severe embargoes on specific raw materials to protect domestic industries. Consequently, the profit margins of several prominent exporters are proven to have shrunk drastically. The exporters must have relied too heavily on international markets instead of cultivating local demand.
Q: What is true about the prominent exporters according to the journal?
options: A. They have successfully shifted to the domestic market.
B. Their profit margins decreased because of the embargoes.
C. They requested the government to impose the embargoes.
D. They are proven to have avoided financial losses.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到因為禁運(embargoes)，導致出口商的利潤率(profit margins)大幅縮水(shrunk drastically)。故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文】Workplace Wellness: Many organizations have been ignoring the early signs of chronic stress among their mid-level managers. This neglect is considered to have accelerated the alarming turnover rate in recent months. The HR executives must have assumed that offering generic wellness apps would be sufficient to prevent burnout.
Q: What mistake did the HR executives likely make?
options: A. They actively fired mid-level managers.
B. They thought simple wellness apps could solve the burnout issue.
C. They spent too much money on psychological counseling.
D. They ignored the turnover rate completely.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文最後一句指出，HR高層一定是假定(must have assumed)提供一般的健康應用程式就足以防止職業倦怠，這是他們的錯誤認知。

normal.desc:
【短文】Architectural Digest: The urban renewal project has been transforming the dilapidated waterfront. The massive steel structures are designed to be aesthetically pleasing while resisting coastal corrosion. However, the initial contractors must have utilized inferior alloys, as rust spots are already visible on the main pillars.
Q: Why are rust spots visible on the pillars?
options: A. The waterfront was too dilapidated to repair.
B. The design was aesthetically flawed from the beginning.
C. The initial contractors likely used low-quality metal mixtures.
D. The coastal corrosion was intentionally ignored by the mayor.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中推測 initial contractors must have utilized inferior alloys（一定使用了劣質合金），導致柱子上已經出現生鏽斑點。alloy 即為金屬混合物。

normal.desc:
【短文】Healthcare Bulletin: Public hospitals have been experiencing severe staffing shortages during the winter surge. The excessive patient load is widely acknowledged to have overwhelmed the emergency responders. The regional health board must have failed to anticipate the severity of this year's seasonal influenza.
Q: What is the regional health board criticized for?
options: A. Hiring too many inexperienced emergency responders.
B. Failing to predict how severe the flu season would be.
C. Closing down public hospitals during the winter.
D. Refusing to acknowledge the staffing shortages.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文最後指出 health board must have failed to anticipate the severity（一定未能預料到嚴重程度），因此 B 是他們受批評的原因。

normal.desc:
【短文】E-commerce Advisory: The platform has been revising its vendor penalty system to curb counterfeit goods. Accounts found selling fake items are immediately suspended, and the funds are held indefinitely. Honest sellers whose accounts were mistakenly blocked must have triggered the automated security algorithm by accident.
Q: What happens to the money of sellers caught selling fake items?
options: A. It is refunded to the buyers immediately.
B. It is held by the platform indefinitely.
C. It is transferred to a secure offshore account.
D. It is used to upgrade the security algorithm.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中明確提到「the funds are held indefinitely（資金被無限期扣留）」。

normal.desc: 【時態】The architecture firm ___ cutting-edge sustainable materials into their residential projects for the past decade.
options: A. incorporate
B. is incorporated
C. has been incorporating
D. will have incorporated
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句尾的「for the past decade」提示動作從過去持續至今，故選現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The surge in teleconsultation adoption is largely presumed ___ by the need for accessible healthcare in rural areas.
options: A. to have been driven
B. to drive
C. driving
D. driven
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：「is presumed to...」後接不定詞，表示「被推測是由...所驅動（已經發生的被動原因）」，需用 to have been driven。

normal.desc: 【推測語氣】The newly imported goods were completely spoiled upon arrival. The logistics team ___ the refrigeration units properly.
options: A. shouldn't inspect
B. must not have inspected
C. cannot inspect
D. will not inspect
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：貨物抵達時全壞了，推測物流團隊過去「一定沒有」好好檢查冷藏設備，用 must not have + p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Are the vendors still complaining about the delayed payments?
B: Yes, they ___ the platform's support center for the last three days without getting any clear answers.
options: A. are flooding
B. have been flooding
C. flood
D. were flooded
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：for the last three days 表示持續了一段時間直到現在的動作，使用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【句子】The unprecedented drop in international shipping costs is understood ___ global supply chain stability significantly.
options: A. to have improved
B. is improving
C. to improve
D. having improved
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：is understood to... 後面接不定詞完成式 (to have improved)，表示「被理解為已經改善了...」。

normal.desc:
【短文】Trade Alert: Multinational corporations have been diversifying their manufacturing hubs to minimize geopolitical risks. This strategic shift is considered to have weakened the monopoly of traditional industrial zones. The local governments in those traditional zones must have felt a severe economic shock as factories relocated en masse.
Q: What is considered a result of corporations diversifying their manufacturing hubs?
options: A. Geopolitical risks have completely disappeared.
B. Traditional industrial zones have lost their dominant position.
C. Local governments have increased their tax revenues.
D. Factories relocated to the traditional industrial zones.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到 This strategic shift is considered to have weakened the monopoly of traditional industrial zones（這被認為削弱了傳統工業區的壟斷地位），即失去優勢地位。

normal.desc:
【短文】Psychology Weekly: We have been tracking the productivity levels of teams operating under extreme pressure. The chronic lack of psychological safety is observed to have eroded their creative problem-solving abilities. The team leaders must have prioritized short-term metrics over the mental health of their subordinates.
Q: According to the text, what happened to teams lacking psychological safety?
options: A. They eventually prioritized short-term metrics.
B. Their ability to solve problems creatively declined.
C. They successfully operated under extreme pressure.
D. Their leaders provided adequate mental health support.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中指出 lack of psychological safety is observed to have eroded their creative problem-solving abilities（侵蝕了他們創造性解決問題的能力）。eroded 對應 declined。

normal.desc: 【時態】The platform developers ___ the user interface continuously to reduce the cart abandonment rate.
options: A. refine
B. are refined
C. have been refining
D. will be refining
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：continuously 配合現在完成進行式，表示「一直持續在改進」。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To create a truly inclusive workplace, management must foster a sense of ___ among employees from diverse backgrounds.
options: A. hostility
B. cohesion
C. discrepancy
D. constraint
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：cohesion 意為「凝聚力、團結」。打造包容的職場需要培養凝聚力。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: The grand opening of the new hospital wing was a disaster; the HVAC system failed entirely.
B: The engineering team ___ the load capacity of the central air conditioning units.
options: A. must have misjudged
B. is misjudging
C. should misjudge
D. to misjudge
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：對系統完全故障的過去事實進行強烈推斷，工程團隊「一定判斷錯誤了」，使用 must have + p.p.。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Are the authorities updating the healthcare privacy laws?
B: Yes, they ___ the data protection protocols rigorously since the massive cyberattack in January.
options: A. review
B. are reviewed
C. have been reviewing
D. will have reviewed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：「since + 過去時間」搭配現在完成進行式，強調動作持續進行。

normal.desc:
【短文】Urban Design Critique: The city council has been championing the pedestrianization of the central business district. However, the sudden ban on vehicles is reported to have drastically reduced the revenue of local retail shops. The planners must have completely neglected the logistical needs of commercial deliveries when drafting the proposal.
Q: What is a consequence of banning vehicles in the district?
options: A. Local retail shops experienced a severe drop in income.
B. Commercial deliveries became much more efficient.
C. The city council abandoned the pedestrianization project.
D. The central business district was relocated.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到 the sudden ban... is reported to have drastically reduced the revenue of local retail shops（大幅減少了當地零售店的收入）。

normal.desc:
【短文】E-Commerce Terms Update: We have been monitoring the recent surge in fraudulent return claims. To combat this, the refund policy is confirmed to have been amended to require photographic evidence for all damaged goods. Buyers who returned items without photos last week must have received an automatic rejection notice.
Q: What must a buyer do now to get a refund for a damaged item?
options: A. Return the item within three days.
B. Pay a return shipping fee.
C. Provide photographic evidence of the damage.
D. Contact the seller directly via phone.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中明確指出 require photographic evidence for all damaged goods（要求提供所有損壞商品的照片證據）。

normal.desc:
【短文】Global Logistics Report: Freight forwarders have been struggling to secure container space for the upcoming holiday season. The artificial scarcity is widely alleged to have been manipulated by major shipping alliances to keep spot rates artificially high. Smaller enterprises must have been forced to pass these exorbitant costs onto the end consumers.
Q: Who is allegedly responsible for the container scarcity?
options: A. Freight forwarders.
B. Major shipping alliances.
C. Smaller enterprises.
D. End consumers.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到 The artificial scarcity is widely alleged to have been manipulated by major shipping alliances（人為的稀缺被廣泛指控是由主要航運聯盟所操縱的）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The late return SURCHARGE is expected to be applied to your final bill.
options: A. 延遲歸還的車輛正在被檢查
B. 最後的帳單已經寄送到您的信箱
C. 延遲歸還的附加費預計會算入最終帳單
D. 附加費用的標準已經被重新評估
normal.explain: The late return surcharge is expected to be applied to your final bill. (延遲歸還的附加費預計會加在您的最終帳單上。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: You must have misplaced the rental agreement folder.
options: A. 您一定是把租車合約資料夾放錯地方了
B. 您必須在租車合約上簽名並放回資料夾
C. 租車合約已經被妥善放在資料夾裡
D. 您不能遺失這份租車合約的影本
normal.explain: You must have misplaced the rental agreement folder. (您一定是把租車合約資料夾放錯地方了。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We have been upgrading our fleet with electric vehicles.
options: A. 我們必須立刻升級所有的電動車
B. 我們一直在用電動車升級我們的車隊
C. 我們的車隊已經不再提供電動車
D. 電動車的維修費用正在不斷攀升
normal.explain: We have been upgrading our fleet with electric vehicles. (我們一直在用電動車升級我們的車隊。)

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Are unlimited MILEAGE options being offered for this specific SUV?
options: A. 這款休旅車的里程數有受到限制嗎？

D. They have been living in the region for centuries.
boss.explain: 短文推論「the builders must have possessed advanced mathematical knowledge」（建造者一定具備先進的數學知識），故選 B。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Policy Paper Summary: The proposed carbon tax has been facing fierce opposition from industrial sectors. Proponents argue that the measure is essential and is proven to have reduced emissions in neighboring countries. The government's failure to consult industry leaders beforehand must have exacerbated the backlash. Q: Why did the policy face a severe backlash according to the passage?
options: A. It failed to reduce emissions in neighboring countries.
B. The government did not communicate with industry leaders in advance.
C. Industrial sectors have been demanding higher taxes.
D. Proponents did not believe the measure was essential.
boss.explain: 文中提到「The government's failure to consult industry leaders beforehand must have exacerbated the backlash」（政府事前未諮詢業界領袖一定加劇了反彈）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Tech News: Developers have been working around the clock to patch a critical vulnerability. The security flaw is reported to have compromised the data of millions of users. The company's stock plummeted following the breach; investors must have panicked over the potential legal liabilities. Q: What was the consequence of the security flaw?
options: A. The developers were sued by the investors.
B. Millions of users lost their internet connection.
C. The company's stock value dropped sharply.
D. The vulnerability was patched before any data was lost.
boss.explain: 文章明確指出「The company's stock plummeted following the breach」（漏洞發生後公司股票暴跌）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Editorial Opinion: The housing crisis is often said to have been caused solely by foreign investors. However, domestic policies have been restricting urban development for decades. The city council must have ignored the growing population metrics when zoning the residential areas. Q: What does the author believe is a major factor in the housing crisis?
options: A. An influx of foreign workers.
B. Restrictive domestic urban development policies.
C. Overdevelopment of residential areas.
D. Accurate tracking of population metrics.
boss.explain: 作者認為雖然常被說是外國投資者造成的，但國內政策數十年來一直在限制都市發展 (domestic policies have been restricting...)，這才是真正的關鍵因素。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Not only ___ a profound impact on the local economy, but the new infrastructure is also expected to attract foreign investment.
options: A. the project has had
B. has the project had
C. the project is having
D. is the project had
boss.explain: 否定副詞 Not only 放句首時，後方需接倒裝句型（助動詞移至主詞前），故選 has the project had。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Medical Breakthrough: A new synthetic compound is purported to have cured several autoimmune diseases in clinical trials. Researchers have been refining its chemical structure to minimize side effects. The initial funding agency must have recognized its immense potential early on, given their continuous financial support. Q: What are researchers currently trying to achieve?
options: A. Secure more funding from the agency.
B. Reduce the side effects of the synthetic compound.
C. Prove that autoimmune diseases are incurable.
D. Patent the chemical structure globally.
boss.explain: 文中指出「Researchers have been refining its chemical structure to minimize side effects」（研究人員一直在改良其化學結構以將副作用降至最低）。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Corporate Memo: The merger with Apex Corp is anticipated to be finalized by the fourth quarter. Both legal teams have been scrutinizing the contractual obligations diligently. Any discrepancies found now must have been overlooked during the initial audit phase. Q: What is implied about the initial audit phase?
options: A. It was conducted flawlessly without errors.
B. It was handled exclusively by Apex Corp.
C. It might not have been thorough enough.
D. It was deliberately delayed by the legal teams.
boss.explain: 文中提到「現在發現的任何差異一定是在初步審計階段被忽略的」，暗示初步審計可能不夠徹底。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Travel Advisory: Travelers have been experiencing unprecedented delays at the international terminal due to a staff strike. The situation is estimated to be resolved within 48 hours. Passengers whose flights were cancelled must have been notified via email or text message. Q: What caused the delays at the international terminal?
options: A. Severe weather conditions.
B. A malfunction in the booking system.
C. A work stoppage by employees.
D. Unprecedented passenger volume.
boss.explain: 短文指出延誤是由於「staff strike」（員工罷工），即選項中的 work stoppage by employees。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Scarcely ___ the press conference when a reporter asked a provocative question about the scandal.
options: A. had the CEO begun
B. the CEO had begun
C. has the CEO begun
D. the CEO began
boss.explain: 否定副詞 Scarcely 放句首時需倒裝，且配合 when 引導的過去式子句，主要子句應用過去完成式，故選 had the CEO begun。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Environmental Report: The shrinking of the ice caps is widely acknowledged to have accelerated over the last decade. Scientists have been urging policymakers to implement stringent regulations. The continuous dismissal of these warnings must have contributed significantly to the current ecological crisis. Q: What is the main point regarding policymakers?
options: A. They have successfully implemented stringent regulations.
B. Their disregard of scientific warnings worsened the crisis.
C. They are widely acknowledged to have accelerated the research.
D. They have been urging scientists to collect more data.
boss.explain: 文中提到「The continuous dismissal of these warnings must have contributed significantly...」（不斷忽視這些警告肯定大大促成了當前的危機），指出決策者的忽視使情況惡化。

boss.desc: 【綜合】Art History Analysis: The stolen masterpiece is now believed to have been smuggled out of the country in a freight container. Detectives have been tracking a notorious art syndicate connected to the heist. Security guards at the museum must have been bribed, as the alarm system was manually disabled. Q: How did the thieves likely manage to disable the alarm system?
options: A. By hacking into the main server.
B. By paying off the museum's security personnel.
C. By smuggling a device in a freight container.
D. By cutting the power supply to the building.
boss.explain: 文中明確推測「Security guards at the museum must have been bribed」（保全一定被收買了），對應選項 B (paying off security personnel)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The true operational costs have been deliberately obscured by the accounting firm.
options: A. 會計師事務所大幅降低了實際的營運成本。
B. 真實的營運成本已經被清晰且透明地公開。
C. 真實的營運成本已被會計師事務所蓄意掩蓋。
D. 會計師事務所發現了營運成本中的重大錯誤。
boss.explain: The true operational costs have been deliberately obscured by the accounting firm. (真實的營運成本已被會計師事務所蓄意掩蓋。) obscure 作動詞指「掩蓋、使模糊」；deliberately 意為「蓄意地」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The domestic economy must have been more resilient to inflation than the experts predicted.
options: A. 國內經濟對通貨膨脹的反應非常脆弱且敏感。
B. 經濟專家極度準確地預測了經濟的反彈趨勢。
C. 國內經濟完全沒有受到任何通貨膨脹的影響。
D. 國內經濟對通膨的抵抗力一定比專家預測的更強。
boss.explain: The domestic economy must have been more resilient to inflation than the experts predicted. (國內經濟對通膨的抵抗力一定比專家預測的更強。) resilient 指「有韌性的、能迅速恢復的」；must have been 表強烈推測。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The consistently high interest rates have been deterring potential foreign investors.
options: A. 持續的高利率一直阻礙著潛在的外國投資者。
B. 持續的高利率成功吸引了大量的外國資金。
C. 潛在的投資者對目前的高利率狀態毫不在乎。
D. 外國投資者持續要求銀行提供更高的利率。
boss.explain: The consistently high interest rates have been deterring potential foreign investors. (持續的高利率一直阻礙著潛在的外國投資者。) deter 指「阻嚇、使打消念頭」；使用現在完成進行式強調此現象持續發生。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: An intricate network of environmental sensors is being installed across the metropolitan area.
options: A. 城市目前正在拆除原本極為複雜的感測器網路。
B. 一個複雜的環境感測器網路正在大都會區安裝中。
C. 一個簡易且基礎的感測器網路已經安裝完畢。
D. 大都會區嚴重缺乏用於監控環境的感測器硬體。
boss.explain: An intricate network of environmental sensors is being installed across the metropolitan area. (一個複雜的環境感測器網路正在大都會區安裝中。) intricate 指「錯綜複雜的」；is being installed 為現在進行被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Several key financial details must have been omitted from the final quarterly report.
options: A. 最終的季度報告完整包含了所有的財務細節。
B. 季度報告中的一些細節被刻意過度強調了。
C. 最終的季報中一定遺漏了幾個關鍵的財務細節。
D. 公司的最終財務報告尚未編寫完成。
boss.explain: Several key financial details must have been omitted from the final quarterly report. (最終的季報中一定遺漏了幾個關鍵的財務細節。) omit 指「遺漏、省略」；must have been omitted 結合了情態動詞與被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: She has been taking a significantly more prominent role in the international trade negotiations.
options: A. I heard she recently resigned from her corporate role.
B. International trade volumes are unfortunately declining.
C. The negotiations have been stalled for weeks anyway.
D. Her leadership has really helped push things forward.
boss.explain: She has been taking a significantly more prominent role in the international trade negotiations. (她在國際貿易談判中一直扮演著更為突出的角色。) prominent 指「突出的、顯著的」；回應讚賞她的領導能力推動了進展最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A rapid shift towards renewable energy sources is being strongly advocated by policy makers.
options: A. 政策制定者正強烈主張迅速轉向再生能源。
B. 政策制定者極力反對在近期內使用再生能源。
C. 轉向再生能源的全球性政策轉型已經徹底完成。
D. 目前沒有任何政府官員支持再生能源的發展計畫。
boss.explain: A rapid shift towards renewable energy sources is being strongly advocated by policy makers. (政策制定者正強烈主張迅速轉向再生能源。) advocate 作動詞指「提倡、主張」；is being strongly advocated 為被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The emergency rescue efforts must have been severely hampered by the unexpected snowstorm.
options: A. Luckily, the snowstorm cleared up very quickly.
B. Yes, it made reaching the remote site almost impossible.
C. The rescue operation was declared a complete success.
D. We unfortunately don't have enough rescue teams right now.
boss.explain: The emergency rescue efforts must have been severely hampered by the unexpected snowstorm. (緊急救援行動一定受到了意外暴風雪的嚴重阻礙。) hamper 指「妨礙、阻礙」；回答「是的，這讓抵達偏遠現場幾乎成為不可能」符合因果關係。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We have been comprehensively analyzing the long-term implications of this major policy shift.
options: A. 我們刻意忽略了這項重大政策轉變可能帶來的長期影響。
B. 專家認為這項重大政策轉變並不會帶來任何實際影響。
C. 我們一直在全面分析這項重大政策轉變的長期影響。
D. 公司高層認為短期的營利影響遠比長期的政策影響重要。
boss.explain: We have been comprehensively analyzing the long-term implications of this major policy shift. (我們一直在全面分析這項重大政策轉變的長期影響。) implication 在此指「可能引發的後果、影響」；comprehensively 意為「全面地」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: A significant portion of the generated revenue is expected to be reinvested into research and development.
options: A. We are actually losing a lot of money this fiscal year.
B. R&D has been entirely defunded by the new management.
C. The revenue was strictly set aside for paying off old debt.
D. That should really help us innovate faster for next year.
boss.explain: A significant portion of the generated revenue is expected to be reinvested into research and development. (產生的一大部分營收預計將重新投資於研發。) revenue 指「營收」；投資研發的回應「那應該能幫助我們明年加速創新」最恰當。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The engineering team must have worked for three consecutive weekends to meet that impossible deadline.
options: A. 工程團隊一定連續工作了三個週末才趕上那個不可能的期限。
B. 即使工程團隊努力了，他們依然錯過了那個最後期限。
C. 為了保持效率，工程團隊在過去的幾個週末都在休息。
D. 工程團隊只花了一個週末的時間就完成了那項困難的工作。
boss.explain: The engineering team must have worked for three consecutive weekends to meet that impossible deadline. (工程團隊一定連續工作了三個週末才趕上那個不可能的期限。) consecutive 指「連續的」；must have worked 推測過去已發生的努力。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The current foreign exchange market situation is considered to be highly volatile at this particular moment.
options: A. The market is completely stable right now, don't worry.
B. Perhaps we should delay our large currency conversion then.
C. Exchange rates basically never change in this region.
D. Volatility is just a myth invented by stock brokers.
boss.explain: The current foreign exchange market situation is considered to be highly volatile at this particular moment. (目前的匯市情況在此刻被認為是高度波動的。) volatile 指「易變的、波動大的」；回應「或許我們該延後大額外幣兌換」是明智的對策。

boss.speak: profitability

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Substantial discrepancies in the financial statements must have been overlooked during the initial audit.
options: A. 財務報表中的重大差異一定是在初步審計時被忽略了。
B. 我們必須在初步審計時找出財務報表中的重大差異。
C. 初步審計時，財務報表中的重大差異並沒有被忽略。
D. 財務報表中的重大差異導致了初步審計的失敗。
boss.explain: 原句：Substantial discrepancies in the financial statements must have been overlooked during the initial audit. 意思：財務報表中的重大差異一定是在初步審計時被忽略了。discrepancy (差異)、overlook (忽略)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The proposed merger has been facing mounting opposition from key shareholders.
options: A. Key shareholders must have proposed a new merger.
B. Are they planning to restructure the deal to appease them?
C. The opposition was mounted on the wall.
D. Mergers are always very agreeable to everyone.
boss.explain: 原句：The proposed merger has been facing mounting opposition from key shareholders.（提議的合併案一直面臨來自主要股東日益增加的反對。）回應 B「他們打算重組交易來安撫他們嗎？」展現對商業困境的理解。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The outdated machinery is slated to be dismantled and replaced by automated robotics.
options: A. 過時的機械預計將被拆除，並由自動化機器人取代。
B. 自動化機器人正在拆除過時的機械。
C. 我們不打算拆除過時的機械，而是直接引入機器人。
D. 過時的機械已經被自動化機器人完全取代了。
boss.explain: 原句：The outdated machinery is slated to be dismantled and replaced by automated robotics. 意思：過時的機械預計將被拆除，並由自動化機器人取代。is slated to be 預計將被...

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The sudden dip in our quarterly earnings must have been triggered by the global supply chain disruptions.
options: A. 季度收益的突然下滑一定是全球供應鏈中斷所引發的。
B. 全球供應鏈中斷必須由季度收益的下滑來觸發。
C. 季度收益的下滑並沒有受到全球供應鏈中斷的影響。
D. 為了防止供應鏈中斷，我們必須接受季度收益下滑。
boss.explain: 原句：The sudden dip in our quarterly earnings must have been triggered by the global supply chain disruptions. 意思：季度收益的突然下滑一定是全球供應鏈中斷所引發的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The research and development department has been spearheading the initiative to utilize biodegradable materials.
options: A. Have they encountered any structural integrity issues with those materials?
B. The department must have thrown a spear at the materials.
C. Biodegradable materials are not biodegradable at all.
D. They will initiate the department soon.
boss.explain: 原句：The R&D department has been spearheading the initiative to utilize biodegradable materials.（研發部門一直主導使用可生物降解材料的倡議。）回應 A「他們使用這些材料有遇到任何結構完整性的問題嗎？」邏輯最通順。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The strict environmental regulations are expected to be enforced rigorously by the newly appointed committee.
options: A. 嚴格的環境法規已經被新成立的委員會廢除了。
B. 預計新成立的委員會將嚴格執行這些環境法規。
C. 新成立的委員會預計將放寬嚴格的環境法規。
D. 新成立的委員會無法嚴格執行環境法規。
boss.explain: 原句：The strict environmental regulations are expected to be enforced rigorously by the newly appointed committee. 意思：預計新成立的委員會將嚴格執行這些環境法規。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The subtle nuances in his speech must have been misinterpreted by the international press.
options: A. 國際媒體一定誤解了他演講中微妙的言外之意。
B. 他必須在演講中向國際媒體解釋微妙的言外之意。
C. 國際媒體完美地詮釋了他演講中微妙的言外之意。
D. 他的演講沒有任何微妙的言外之意讓國際媒體誤解。
boss.explain: 原句：The subtle nuances in his speech must have been misinterpreted by the international press. 意思：國際媒體一定誤解了他演講中微妙的言外之意。nuance 指細微差別、言外之意。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: We have been revamping the entire user interface to enhance the overall customer experience.
options: A. The customer experience must have been revamped.
B. When is the rollout date for the new design?
C. We should user interface the entire customer.

D. 這項具爭議的政策是為了平息公眾的強烈抗議而制定的。
boss.explain: 原句：The controversial policy is presumed to be abandoned following the massive public outcry. 意思：在大規模的公眾強烈抗議之後，這項具爭議的政策預計將被放棄。is presumed to be (推測將被)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

boss.explain: 原句：The sudden resignation of the chief financial officer must have exacerbated the investors' panic. 意思：財務長的突然辭職一定加劇了投資者的恐慌。exacerbate 加劇、惡化。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

B. 最初的專利申請被視為有效，並將成為技術參考。
C. 我們必須使最初的專利申請失效以引用先前的技術。
D. 先前的技術參考文獻因最初的專利申請而無效。
boss.explain: 原句：The initial patent application is deemed to be invalid due to prior art references. 意思：最初的專利申請因先前的技術參考文獻被視為無效。is deemed to be (被視為)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Legal Brief: Section 4 of the employment contract has been undergoing major revisions. The termination clause is considered to have been too ambiguous in the previous version. The drafting committee must have realized that a clearer definition of gross misconduct was necessary to protect the company from wrongful dismissal lawsuits. Q: Why was Section 4 revised?
options: A. To provide more vacation days for employees.
B. Because the previous termination rules lacked clarity.
C. To prevent the drafting committee from resigning.
D. Because lawsuits have bankrupted the company.
boss.explain: 文中提到 termination clause is considered to have been too ambiguous (解雇條款被認為太過模稜兩可)，且需要 clearer definition (更清晰的定義)，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Notice of Liability: The contractor has been ignoring our repeated warnings regarding the use of substandard materials. Consequently, the structural damage is determined to be solely their responsibility. They must have intentionally bypassed the rigorous quality checks to cut costs. Legal proceedings will commence shortly. Q: What is the contractor accused of doing?
options: A. Delaying the project timeline on purpose.
B. Skipping required quality inspections to save money.
C. Suing the company for unreasonable demands.
D. Overcharging for the standard materials used.
boss.explain: 文中提到 They must have intentionally bypassed the rigorous quality checks to cut costs (他們一定為了省成本而故意繞過嚴格的品質檢驗)，對應選項 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】HR Announcement: We have been evaluating our current health benefits package for the past six months. The updated dental plan is slated to be launched in January. Employees who missed the open enrollment period must have overlooked the multiple reminder emails sent last week. Q: What is true about the updated dental plan?
options: A. It has already been implemented.
B. It will be introduced at the beginning of the year.
C. It was rejected by the employees.
D. It replaces the mandatory health checkup.
boss.explain: 文中指出 The updated dental plan is slated to be launched in January (預計於一月推出)，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Policy Update: The travel reimbursement process has been causing frustration among staff members. The finance team is reported to have overhauled the entire system to ensure faster payouts. Staff members who submitted claims last month must have noticed the significantly reduced processing time. Q: What was the main issue with the previous reimbursement process?
options: A. It required too many physical receipts.
B. It paid out in the wrong currency.
C. It was too slow and frustrated the employees.
D. It was only available to senior management.
boss.explain: 文中提到 causing frustration，並說財務團隊徹底改革系統 to ensure faster payouts (以確保更快的撥款)，代表以前的問題是太慢，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Abstract: Our team has been conducting longitudinal surveys on sleep deprivation among teenagers. The cognitive decline observed in the subjects is hypothesized to have been exacerbated by excessive screen time before bed. Previous studies must have failed to account for the blue light emission from modern smartphones. Q: What factor did previous studies likely miss according to the abstract?
options: A. The average sleep duration of adults.
B. The impact of blue light from modern phones.
C. The dietary habits of the subjects.
D. The academic pressure teenagers face.
boss.explain: 短文最後一句明確指出 Previous studies must have failed to account for the blue light emission from modern smartphones (之前的研究一定沒將現代手機的藍光輻射納入考量)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Abstract Snippet: Scientists have been attempting to synthesize a room-temperature superconductor for decades. The recent breakthrough is widely considered to be a pivotal moment in electrical engineering. The lead researcher must have utilized a completely novel crystalline structure, as traditional models consistently failed. Q: How does the recent breakthrough differ from past attempts?
options: A. It took less time to achieve.
B. It relied on traditional, proven models.
C. It likely used a new structural approach.
D. It was accidental and unplanned.
boss.explain: 文中提到 lead researcher must have utilized a completely novel crystalline structure (一定使用了一種全新的晶體結構)，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Travel Insight: The hospitality industry has been adapting to the rise of "bleisure" travel—combining business with leisure. Many luxury resorts are reported to have upgraded their business centers to accommodate remote workers. Hotel managers must have realized that free Wi-Fi is no longer sufficient to attract this new demographic. Q: What is the main reason luxury resorts are upgrading their facilities?
options: A. To comply with new safety regulations.
B. To meet the needs of travelers mixing work and vacation.
C. To host international political summits.
D. To reduce their overall energy consumption.
boss.explain: 文章首句定義 bleisure 為 combining business with leisure，並提到度假村升級商務中心以 accommodate remote workers (容納遠端工作者)，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Industry Report: Sustainable tourism has been gaining immense traction among millennials. The carbon footprint of commercial flights is acknowledged to be a major concern for these environmentally conscious travelers. Airlines must have noticed this trend, as many are now offering carbon offset programs at checkout. Q: How are airlines responding to the new trend among millennial travelers?
options: A. By stopping all international flights.
B. By offering cheaper tickets to millennials.
C. By providing options to neutralize travel emissions.
D. By forcing passengers to plant trees.
boss.explain: 文中提到 airlines ... are now offering carbon offset programs (航空公司現在提供碳補償計畫)，即提供中和碳排的選項 (neutralize travel emissions)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Book Review: The author has been weaving intricate political allegories into her fantasy worlds for years. Her latest work is said to have been inspired by the European industrial revolution. Readers familiar with her style must have quickly identified the parallels between the fictional empire and 19th-century Britain. Q: What is the primary inspiration for the author's latest book?
options: A. The author's personal childhood memories.
B. The industrial revolution in Europe.
C. A recent political scandal in modern Britain.
D. Classical Greek mythology.
boss.explain: 文中直接說明 Her latest work is said to have been inspired by the European industrial revolution (據說靈感來自歐洲工業革命)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Critique: Throughout the memoir, the writer has been attempting to justify his controversial political decisions. However, his account is proven to have omitted several key events that contradict his narrative. He must have assumed that his audience would not fact-check his highly biased timeline. Q: What is the main criticism of the memoir?
options: A. It deliberately leaves out information that goes against the writer's views.
B. It is too long and difficult to understand.
C. It focuses too much on the writer's personal life.
D. It was published without the publisher's consent.
boss.explain: 文中批評 omitted several key events that contradict his narrative (遺漏了數個與其敘述矛盾的關鍵事件)，即故意略過不利資訊，故選 A。

boss.desc: 【綜合】The ancient manuscript, which ___ in a forgotten monastery, is currently being authenticated. The monks who preserved it ___ extraordinary measures to protect it from moisture.

C. are fluctuating / creating
D. fluctuated / created
boss.explain: 前半句強調這個月以來持續的波動，用 have been fluctuating；後半句表示投機客被認為「已經製造了」人為短缺，用 to have created。

boss.desc: 【短文】Market Analysis: Tech stocks have been taking a hit lately. The sudden crash of Apex Inc. is alleged to have been orchestrated by massive institutional sell-offs. Retail investors, caught off guard, must have lost millions overnight. The market volatility highlights the need for a diversified ___ to absorb such sudden shocks. Q: Which word best completes the text?
options: A. mandate
B. portfolio
C. allegation
D. backlash
boss.explain: 投資人需要一個多樣化的「投資組合 (portfolio)」來吸收市場衝擊。mandate 為命令，allegation 為指控。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】Local authorities ___ the factory's wastewater discharge for weeks. The toxic chemicals are confirmed ___ heavy damage to the nearby wetlands.
options: A. have been tracking / to have caused
B. tracked / to cause
C. are tracking / causing
D. had tracked / to have been caused
boss.explain: 第一格表示持續數週的追蹤 (have been tracking)。第二格表示化學物質被確認「已經造成」損害，主動語態完成式不定詞 (to have caused)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Ecological Update: Activists have been protesting the new mining mandate for over a month. The excavation process is argued to have irreparably depleted the underground aquifers. The local government must have prioritized short-term economic gains over long-term sustainability. Q: What is the main criticism against the local government?
options: A. They failed to pay the activists.
B. They valued quick money over the environment.
C. They ordered the aquifers to be filled.
D. They stopped the mining mandate.
boss.explain: 文中提到政府一定把短期經濟利益看得比長期永續性更重要 (prioritized short-term economic gains over long-term sustainability)，選項 B 最符合。

boss.desc: 【短文】Compliance Memo: All manufacturing branches have been struggling to meet the new emission targets. The old ventilation systems are known to have continuously leaked hazardous gases. The facility managers must have delayed the necessary upgrades to avoid budget overruns. Now, they must immediately ___ the old systems and install compliant ones. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. dismantle
B. liquidate
C. speculate
D. fluctuate
boss.explain: 為了升級，必須「拆除 (dismantle)」舊系統並安裝合規的新系統。liquidate 為清算資產，speculate 為投機。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】Customers ___ of faulty wiring in the blenders since May. The severe overheating is suspected ___ several kitchen fires last week.
options: A. complain / to cause
B. have been complaining / to have caused
C. complained / causing
D. had complained / to be caused
boss.explain: 第一格用現在完成進行式表示自五月以來持續的抱怨；第二格用 to have caused 表示「過去被懷疑造成了火災」。

boss.desc: 【短文】Automotive Recall: We have been investigating the spontaneous airbag deployments in our 2025 sedans. The sensors are discovered to have been compromised by a substandard microchip. The chip supplier must have skipped the rigorous extreme-temperature testing phase. Vehicle owners are advised to avoid driving until the repair is completed. Q: What is the root cause of the airbag issue?
options: A. Extreme temperatures
B. A low-quality microchip
C. Aggressive driving
D. Expired sensors
boss.explain: 文中指出感測器因為一個劣質微晶片 (substandard microchip) 而出現問題。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】Researchers ___ the monkeys' reactions to mirror reflections. The cognitive breakthrough is reported ___ earlier than initially predicted.
options: A. have been observing / to have occurred
B. observe / to occur
C. are observing / occurring
D. observed / to have been occurred
boss.explain: 研究員一直持續觀察 (have been observing)；認知突破據報導發生得比預期早，用 to have occurred (occur 不用被動)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Behavioral Study: We have been analyzing the correlation between sleep deprivation and risk-taking. Subjects lacking sleep are shown to have deviated significantly from logical decision-making models. They must have relied heavily on emotional impulses rather than rational thought. Q: How did sleep-deprived subjects make decisions?
options: A. Through careful logical deduction.
B. By following strict rational models.
C. Based mostly on emotional impulses.
D. By avoiding any risk-taking behavior.
boss.explain: 文章提到他們一定非常依賴情緒衝動 (relied heavily on emotional impulses)。

boss.desc: 【綜合語法】The CEO's questionable tax records ___ intense public scrutiny. The missing documents are assumed ___ deliberately destroyed before the audit.
options: A. draw / to be
B. have been drawing / to have been
C. are drawing / having been
D. drew / to have
boss.explain: 一直在引來公眾審視用 have been drawing；文件被假設「已經被銷毀」，用完成式被動不定詞 to have been destroyed。

boss.desc: 【短文】Corporate Crisis Press Release: Our legal team has been addressing the recent allegations of corporate espionage. The stolen data is confirmed to have been sold to a rival firm on the dark web. The former head of IT must have orchestrated the breach, as he had the highest level of clearance. We are working closely with cyber authorities. Q: Who is believed to be responsible for the data breach?
options: A. The cyber authorities
B. The legal team
C. A rival firm
D. The former head of IT
boss.explain: 文中明確指出「The former head of IT must have orchestrated the breach」(前IT主管一定策劃了這起外洩)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Internal Leak: Employees have been expressing outrage over the hidden executive bonuses. The board's attempt to cover up the payments is proven to have worsened the public ___. They must have underestimated the staff's demand for transparency and accountability. Q: Which word fits the blank best?
options: A. backlash
B. compliance
C. dividend
D. portfolio
boss.explain: 董事會掩蓋獎金的行為加劇了公眾的「強烈反彈 (backlash)」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The liability clauses are anticipated to be strictly enforced by the claims department.
options: A. Then we must have misunderstood the terms.
B. We have been claiming the rewards today.
C. The department was built last month.
D. She must have strictly enforced the rules.
boss.explain: 原句：The liability clauses are anticipated to be strictly enforced by the claims department. (預計理賠部門將嚴格執行責任條款。) 選項 A (那我們一定是誤解了條款) 最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The structural integrity of the roof has been deteriorating despite our repairs.
options: A. 儘管我們進行了維修，屋頂的結構完整性仍在惡化
B. 屋頂已經完全修復，不再有結構問題
C. 我們決定放棄維修，直接拆除整個屋頂
D. 結構工程師保證屋頂絕對安全無虞
boss.explain: 原句：The structural integrity of the roof has been deteriorating despite our repairs. (儘管我們進行了維修，屋頂的結構完整性仍在惡化。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The safety inspector must have noticed the frayed cables near the generator.
options: A. 檢查員認為發電機附近的電纜非常安全
B. 安全檢查員一定是注意到了發電機附近磨損的電纜
C. 檢查員要求工人立刻更換所有的發電機
D. 工人們故意隱瞞了電纜磨損的事實
boss.explain: 原句：The safety inspector must have noticed the frayed cables near the generator. (安全檢查員一定是注意到了發電機附近磨損的電纜。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The retrospective exhibition is intended to be a tribute to his entire career.
options: A. He has been painting the tribute for weeks.
B. It must have drawn crowds of his admirers.
C. I will exhibit my own work tomorrow.
D. The career center is open on Mondays.
boss.explain: 原句：The retrospective exhibition is intended to be a tribute to his entire career. (這場回顧展旨在向他的整個職業生涯致敬。) 選項 B (這一定吸引了大批他的仰慕者) 最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Several prominent critics have been analyzing the symbolic motifs in this collection.
options: A. 評論家們認為這個系列的作品缺乏象徵意義
B. 幾位著名的評論家一直在分析這個系列中的象徵性主題
C. 藝術家拒絕向評論家解釋作品中的主題
D. 觀眾對於作品中複雜的象徵感到非常困惑
boss.explain: 原句：Several prominent critics have been analyzing the symbolic motifs in this collection. (幾位著名的評論家一直在分析這個系列中的象徵性主題。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The auctioneer must have overlooked her bid in the heat of the moment.
options: A. 拍賣官拒絕接受她過低的報價
B. 她在最後一刻決定撤回自己的出價
C. 拍賣官在激烈的競標中一定忽略了她的出價
D. 拍賣官成功幫她標下了這件藝術品
boss.explain: 原句：The auctioneer must have overlooked her bid in the heat of the moment. (拍賣官在激烈的競標中一定忽略了她的出價。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The reigning champion is perceived to be unbeatable on this specific terrain.
options: A. They must have lost the previous game.
B. Yes, his agility here is truly unmatched.
C. The terrain is flat and very easy.
D. I have been championing this cause for years.
boss.explain: 原句：The reigning champion is perceived to be unbeatable on this specific terrain. (這位衛冕冠軍在這種特定的地形上被認為是不可戰勝的。) 選項 B (是的，他在這裡的敏捷度真的無人能及) 最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We have been scrutinizing the opponent's defensive formations for days.
options: A. 我們這幾天一直在仔細審視對手的防守陣型
B. 對手的防守陣型幾乎完美無瑕
C. 我們決定放棄研究對手，專注於自身的進攻
D. 教練對於球隊糟糕的防守感到非常憤怒
boss.explain: 原句：We have been scrutinizing the opponent's defensive formations for days. (我們這幾天一直在仔細審視對手的防守陣型。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The underdog must have capitalized on that rare unforced error.
options: A. 處於劣勢的一方在比賽中犯下了一個嚴重的失誤
B. 劣勢方一定利用了那個罕見的非受迫性失誤
C. 強隊故意製造失誤來讓對手得分
D. 裁判判斷這是一個合理的技術性犯規
boss.explain: 原句：The underdog must have capitalized on that rare unforced error. (劣勢方一定利用了那個罕見的非受迫性失誤。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The executive coaching sessions are purported to be highly transformative.
options: A. I have been transforming the raw data.
B. Indeed, several managers spoke highly of them.
C. The coach must have missed the bus.
D. The sessions were unfortunately cancelled.
boss.explain: 原句：The executive coaching sessions are purported to be highly transformative. (高階主管教練課程據說非常具有變革性。) 選項 B (的確，有幾位經理對此評價很高) 最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They have been advocating for more inclusive hiring practices within the sector.
options: A. 他們拒絕在業界內推行任何新的招聘政策
B. 這個產業的招聘標準變得越來越嚴格
C. 他們一直在提倡業界內採取更具包容性的招聘實務
D. 公司決定解雇所有不符合包容性標準的員工
boss.explain: 原句：They have been advocating for more inclusive hiring practices within the sector. (他們一直在提倡業界內採取更具包容性的招聘實務。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Her exceptional portfolio must have distinguished her from the other candidates.
options: A. 她的作品集太過普通，未能吸引面試官的注意
B. 她出色的作品集一定讓她在其他候選人中脫穎而出
C. 其他候選人的作品集比她的更加優秀
D. 面試官根本沒有看她的作品集
boss.explain: 原句：Her exceptional portfolio must have distinguished her from the other candidates. (她出色的作品集一定讓她在其他候選人中脫穎而出。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: A comprehensive skills assessment is required to be completed by all attendees.
options: A. I will assess the damages immediately.
B. I have been looking for the test link. Where is it?
C. We must have assessed the wrong property.
D. The skills were acquired long ago.
boss.explain: 原句：A comprehensive skills assessment is required to be completed by all attendees. (所有與會者都必須完成一項全面的技能評估。) 選項 B (我一直在找測驗的連結。它在哪裡？) 最合理。

boss.desc:
【短文】HR Memo: The management has been reviewing the turnover metrics for the past quarter. The rigid office hours are suspected to have alienated our top performers. We must have ignored their requests for a better work-life balance for far too long.
Q: What is considered the main reason for losing top performers?
options: A. Low salaries
B. Inflexible schedules
C. Poor management
D. Lack of training
boss.explain: 文中提到「rigid office hours (僵化的辦公時間)」，也就是缺乏彈性的行程 (Inflexible schedules) 導致留不住優秀人才。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The department head's abrupt departure is presumed ___ by the crushing workload and insufficient administrative support.
options: A. to trigger
B. to be triggering
C. to have been triggered
D. triggering
boss.explain: 部門主管的離職被假定是「由龐大的工作量所引起的」。事情已發生且為被動，因此使用完成式被動不定詞 to have been triggered。

boss.desc: 【時態】The retention rate ___ gradually since the executives introduced a hybrid work model.
options: A. climbs
B. climbed
C. is climbing
D. has been climbing
boss.explain: 句中有 since 帶出的過去時間點，主句需用現在完成進行式，表示留任率從那時起持續在攀升中。

boss.desc:
【短文】Editorial: The proposed congestion pricing is said to have disproportionately affected low-income drivers. The policy makers must have prioritized municipal revenue over social equity when drafting the bill.
Q: What is the author's criticism of the policy makers?
options: A. They cared more about making money than fairness.
B. They built too many roads.
C. They ignored the environment.
D. They lowered taxes too much.
boss.explain: 社論批評政策制定者「prioritized municipal revenue over social equity (把市政收入置於社會公平之上)」，即只顧賺錢不顧公平。

boss.desc: 【推測語氣】The subway station was completely flooded during the storm. The city engineers ___ the drainage capacity accurately.
options: A. calculate
B. must not have calculated
C. should calculate
D. calculated
boss.explain: 地鐵站被淹沒了，可以強烈推斷工程師當時「一定沒有」準確計算好排水量，需用 must not have + V-p.p.。

boss.desc: 【時態】The local government ___ the subway fares continuously, causing widespread public outrage among daily commuters.
options: A. is hiked
B. hikes
C. has been hiking
D. hike
boss.explain: continuously 強調動作一直延續至今，政府不斷調漲票價，因此使用現在完成進行式 has been hiking。

boss.desc:
【短文】Investigative Report: The local dairy farm has been operating without a valid license. Their raw milk products are alleged to have caused a regional outbreak of listeria. The facility managers must have bribed the inspectors to ignore the gross health code violations.
Q: What did the factory managers allegedly do?
options: A. They improved sanitation.
B. They sold the farm.
C. They stopped production.
D. They paid off officials.
boss.explain: 文中指出經理「bribed the inspectors (賄賂檢查員)」，與 paid off officials 意思一致。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden closure of the popular bakery chain is rumored ___ by a severe pest infestation in their central kitchen.
options: A. to have been prompted
B. to prompt
C. prompting
D. to be prompted
boss.explain: 關店謠傳是「被」嚴重的蟲害所引起的。因為動作發生在過去且是被動，需用 to have been prompted。

boss.desc:
【短文】Article: Security experts have been monitoring the new smart home devices. The built-in microphones are proven to have recorded private conversations without consent. The manufacturer must have intentionally hidden this tracking feature deep within the terms of service.
Q: What is the main concern regarding the smart devices?
options: A. They are too expensive.
B. They secretly record users.
C. They break down easily.
D. They consume too much power.
boss.explain: 文章指出麥克風在未經同意下錄下私人對話 (recorded private conversations without consent)，即暗中錄音。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The deployment of unregulated surveillance drones is feared ___ a chilling effect on public gatherings and free speech.
options: A. casting
B. to be cast
C. to have cast
D. cast
boss.explain: 無人機的部署被恐懼「已經產生了 (cast)」寒蟬效應，因是主動發出的動作且強調已造成影響，故選 to have cast。

boss.desc: 【推測語氣】The AI system completely failed to recognize the regional accents. The developers ___ it exclusively on standard dialects.
options: A. train
B. are training
C. should train
D. must have trained
boss.explain: 系統完全無法辨識地方口音，可推斷開發者當時「一定只用了」標準方言來訓練它，用 must have + V-p.p. 表過去的肯定推測。

boss.desc:
【短文】Marketing Review: Our rival brand has been dominating the digital space. Their latest interactive billboard is recognized to have captivated millions of pedestrians. Their creative team must have spent months studying foot traffic patterns to maximize visual impact.
Q: Why was the rival's billboard successful?
options: A. It was placed strategically based on data.
B. It was cheaper to produce.
C. It offered free samples.
D. It was endorsed by a celebrity.
boss.explain: 評論提到團隊「spent months studying foot traffic patterns (花了數月研究人潮模式)」，這代表廣告的成功是因為基於數據的策略性放置。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The sudden rebranding effort is widely believed ___ by the new CEO's desire to distance the company from past scandals.
options: A. to drive
B. to have been driven
C. driving
D. driven
boss.explain: 品牌重塑被認為是「被新任CEO的渴望所驅動的」。已發生且為被動語態，需用 to have been driven。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

options: A. Yes, his foresight really saved us from total paralysis today.
B. We have been ignoring the contingency plan completely.
C. The nightmare is predicted to be wonderful.
D. He must have slept through the entire crisis.
boss.explain: The regional manager must have been anticipating this logistical nightmare when he requested the contingency plan. (區域經理要求制定應急計畫時，一定早就預料到這場物流噩夢了。) 回應 A (是的，他的遠見確實拯救了我們今天免於全面癱瘓) 最契合語境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

options: A. 整個貨運網絡正在減班以節省成本
B. 據稱整個貨運網絡正以最大產能運作以清理積壓的貨物
C. 貨運網絡已經完全癱瘓
D. 積壓的貨物已經全數被銷毀
boss.explain: The entire freight network is purported to be operating at maximum capacity to clear the backlog. (據稱，整個貨運網絡正以最大負載運作，以清除積壓的貨物。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The exorbitant prices on the menu must have deterred a significant portion of their target demographic.
options: A. I have been eating there every day.
B. Exactly, many locals feel priced out and no longer visit.
C. The menu is expected to be incredibly cheap.
D. They must have deterred the chef from cooking.
boss.explain: The exorbitant prices on the menu must have deterred a significant portion of their target demographic. (菜單上高昂的價格一定嚇退了他們很大一部分的目標客群。) 回應 B (沒錯，許多當地人覺得價格太高而不再光顧) 是最精準的回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

options: A. 這道菜的口味非常單調且無趣
B. 這道菜複雜的風味層次旨在讓味蕾慢慢去解析感受
C. 廚師希望客人快速吃完這道菜
D. 這道菜的味道過於強烈，難以下嚥
boss.explain: The complex flavor profile of this dish is intended to be unraveled slowly on the palate. (這道菜複雜的風味特徵是為了讓味蕾細細品味、慢慢解開而設計的。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

options: A. Yes, the committee grilled me on my theoretical framework for hours.
B. We have been accepting the premise without question.
C. The research is scheduled to be canceled.
D. I must have defended the committee.
boss.explain: The underlying premise of your research must have been challenged vigorously during the defense. (你研究的潛在前提在口試辯護時一定受到了強烈的質疑。) 回應 A (是的，委員會對我的理論框架盤問了好幾個小時) 正確對應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

boss.explain: These statistical anomalies are generally presumed to be caused by flaws in the sampling methodology. (這些統計上的異常現象通常被推斷是由抽樣方法中的瑕疵引起的。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

boss.explain: The incumbent governor must have deliberately evaded the reporter's question about the corruption scandal. (現任州長一定是故意迴避了記者關於貪污醜聞的提問。) 回應 B (絕對是，他轉移話題到基礎設施是經典的閃避策略) 語意相符。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

B. It appears so; the logs show an intrusion at precisely 3 AM.

boss.explain: The malicious ransomware must have circumvented our firewalls during the scheduled maintenance window. (惡意勒索軟體一定是在預定的維護時段繞過了我們的防火牆。) 回應 B (看來是這樣；日誌顯示正好在凌晨三點有入侵跡象) 完全符合資安情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

C. 只有嚴重的錯誤才需要被記錄

boss.explain: Routine system diagnostics are strictly required to be logged in the centralized repository. (嚴格規定例行的系統診斷結果必須被記錄在集中的儲存庫中。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

options: A. The operational integrity is flawless.
B. Indeed, several client accounts are currently unrecoverable.
C. We have been compromising the data deliberately.
D. The loss must have been a great benefit.
boss.explain: The sudden data loss must have severely compromised our operational integrity. (突如其來的數據遺失一定嚴重損害了我們的營運完整性。) 回應 B (確實，好幾個客戶帳戶目前無法恢復) 反映了嚴重性。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Redundancy protocols are strategically designed to be triggered upon primary server failure.
options: A. 備援協定被設計在主伺服器正常運作時關閉
B. 備援協定經策略性設計，會在主伺服器故障時觸發
C. 主伺服器故障時會導致所有資料被刪除
D. 這些協定完全沒有備份的作用
boss.explain: Redundancy protocols are strategically designed to be triggered upon primary server failure. (備援協定經過策略性設計，以便在主伺服器故障時被觸發。)

boss.desc: 【綜合文法】Not only ___ our market share, but we have also been outperforming industry benchmarks consistently.
options: A. the new product boosted
B. has the new product boosted
C. the new product has boosted
D. did the new product boosted
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：Not only 置於句首時，其後的子句需倒裝 (助動詞移至主詞前)。後半句用現在完成進行式，前半句配合語意用現在完成式倒裝，has the new product boosted。選項 B 正確；D 助動詞 did 後面動詞未還原，為語法錯誤。

boss.desc:
【短文】Letter to Shareholders: Over the past year, we have been revamping our core software architecture. The legacy system is widely acknowledged to have hindered our agility. Our early investors must have worried about the technological debt we accumulated. Fortunately, the transition is now complete.
Q: What was the problem with the legacy system?
options: A. It was too expensive to maintain
B. It slowed down the company's responsiveness
C. It caused massive data leaks
D. It was not accessible to early investors
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中指出舊系統 (legacy system)「hindered our agility (阻礙了我們的敏捷度)」。agility 指敏捷度、反應速度，選項 B (slowed down responsiveness) 為其同義改寫，故為正解。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The sudden mutation in the virus strain is highly ___ to the development of our new vaccine, rendering it less effective.
options: A. resilient
B. evocative
C. detrimental
D. immersive
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：detrimental 意為「有害的、不利的」。句意為病毒株的突變對疫苗開發「極為不利」，導致其效果降低。其他選項 (A 韌性的，B 喚起情感的，D 沉浸式的) 完全不合邏輯。

boss.desc:
【短文】Neuro-Science: Neuroscientists have been mapping the brain's neural pathways during deep sleep. Memory consolidation is proven to be facilitated by these slow-wave patterns. Individuals who sleep poorly must have experienced a significant disruption in this critical restorative phase.
Q: What happens during slow-wave sleep?
options: A. Neural pathways are permanently destroyed
B. Memories are strengthened and organized
C. The brain stops all internal activity
D. Individuals experience vivid nightmares
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章提到 Memory consolidation (記憶鞏固/強化) 是由慢波模式 (slow-wave patterns) 促進的。選項 B「記憶被強化與組織」正是 consolidation 的意義。

boss.desc: 【綜合文法】Scarcely ___ the new recycling initiative when they realized they lacked the facilities to process the collected materials.
options: A. the city had launched
B. did the city launch
C. had the city launched
D. the city launched
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：否定副詞 Scarcely (幾乎不/一...就...) 置於句首時，主要子句需倒裝，通常搭配過去完成式 (had + S + p.p.)，後面跟 when 加上過去式子句。選項 C (had the city launched) 完全符合倒裝與時態規則。

boss.desc:
【短文】Opinion Page: We have been enduring endless traffic jams since the bridge repair began. The detour routes are proven to have been poorly planned. The urban planners must have relied on outdated traffic models, as they completely failed to account for rush-hour volume.
Q: Why are the detour routes ineffective?
options: A. They are too narrow for commercial trucks
B. The planners used old and inaccurate traffic data
C. Rush-hour volume has decreased recently
D. The bridge repair was unexpectedly canceled
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：投書中提到都市計畫者「must have relied on outdated traffic models (一定依賴了過時的交通模型)」，導致無法應付尖峰時段車流。選項 B (使用舊且不準確的數據) 為正解。

boss.desc: 【綜合文法】Only after the whistleblower leaked the internal memos ___ the true extent of the corporate fraud.
options: A. the public realized
B. did the public realize
C. the public has realized
D. has the public realized
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：Only after 帶領的副詞子句置於句首時，後面的主要子句必須倒裝 (助動詞 + 主詞 + 動詞)。又因為 leak 是過去式，主要子句也應為過去式倒裝，選項 B (did the public realize) 為正解。

boss.desc:
【短文】Judicial Review: The tech giant has been appealing the heavy fines imposed by the European Union. Their data collection practices are alleged to have infringed upon user privacy rights. The company's compliance officers must have deliberately bypassed the regional regulations.
Q: Why was the tech giant fined?
options: A. For failing to pay corporate taxes
B. For allegedly violating user privacy laws
C. For appealing the European Union's decision
D. For firing their compliance officers
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及「Their data collection practices are alleged to have infringed upon user privacy rights (他們的資料收集行為據稱侵犯了用戶隱私權)」。infringe upon 意為侵犯，選項 B (violating user privacy laws) 符合。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The artist's refusal to provide any description for his abstract paintings leaves their meaning completely open to ___.
options: A. transparency
B. consolidation
C. interpretation
D. plumage
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：open to interpretation 是一個常見片語，意為「開放給人自由詮釋」。藝術家不提供文字說明，使得抽象畫的意義完全開放給觀眾各自解讀。選項 C 正確。

boss.desc:
【短文】Gallery Review: The historical society has been showcasing a collection of rare medieval artifacts. A magnificent jewel-encrusted sword is purported to have belonged to a legendary king. The craftsmen who forged it must have possessed unparalleled metallurgical skills.
Q: What is said about the sword's creators?
options: A. They were members of the royal family
B. They were highly skilled in metalworking
C. They stole the jewels from a legendary king
D. They left detailed blueprints for the historical society
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中稱讚鍛造這把劍的工匠 (craftsmen)「must have possessed unparalleled metallurgical skills (一定擁有無與倫比的冶金/金屬加工技巧)」。選項 B (highly skilled in metalworking) 是準確的改寫。

boss.desc:
【短文】Science Weekly: Researchers have been observing the peculiar mating rituals of the bird of paradise. The vibrant plumage is considered to have evolved specifically to attract mates in dense jungles. The ancestors of these birds must have faced intense sexual selection pressures.
Q: Why did the vibrant plumage evolve?
options: A. To camouflage the birds in dense jungles
B. To attract potential mating partners
C. To frighten away dangerous predators
D. To help the birds fly faster
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章明確指出鮮豔的羽毛 (vibrant plumage) 被認為是為了「attract mates (吸引配偶)」而演化出來的。選項 B (attract potential mating partners) 完全相符。

boss.desc:
【短文】Exhibition Critique: We have been waiting in line for hours to see the immersive digital art show. The visual projections are reported to have crashed twice during the morning session. The technical team must have overlooked a fatal bug in the rendering software.
Q: What issue occurred during the morning session?
options: A. The gallery was closed due to a power outage
B. The visual projections failed to operate correctly
C. The technical team resigned unexpectedly
D. The audience refused to wait in line
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及「The visual projections are reported to have crashed twice (視覺投影據報崩潰了兩次)」，意即系統無法正常運作。選項 B 準確描述了投影失敗的問題。

boss.speak: They must have deliberately concealed the recent cuts to our dental coverage.
options: A. The dentist is available on Friday morning.
B. I need to buy a new cover for my smartphone.
C. That explains the sudden outrage from the staff.
D. We should conceal our identities for safety.
boss.explain: 英文：They must have deliberately concealed the recent cuts to our dental coverage. 意思：他們一定是刻意隱瞞了最近對我們牙科保險的削減。C「那解釋了為何員工會突然感到憤怒」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The windshield wipers are supposed to be included in the basic warranty, correct?
options: A. Yes, the weather is quite stormy today.
B. I wiped the windows clean this morning.
C. The mechanic is busy fixing another car.
D. Actually, they are considered normal wear and tear.
boss.explain: 英文：The windshield wipers are supposed to be included in the basic warranty, correct? 意思：雨刷應該包含在基本保固裡，對嗎？D「其實，它們被視為正常的耗損」最符合汽車保固常理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The internal computer system must have bypassed the minor electrical fault.
options: A. 內部的電腦系統一定是繞過了這個輕微的電力故障。
B. 維修人員不小心扯斷了引擎室裡的電線。
C. 汽車的電池因為過度充電而發生了爆炸。
D. 這台車的導航系統經常在偏遠地區失去訊號。
boss.explain: 英文：The internal computer system must have bypassed the minor electrical fault. 意思：內部的電腦系統一定是繞過了這個輕微的電力故障。bypass 意為繞過、避開。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The brake pads have been wearing out unevenly due to a misaligned suspension.
options: A. I will pad the box with some extra foam.
B. Should I authorize a complete suspension replacement then?
C. The road has been very smooth lately.
D. Please wear a helmet while riding the motorcycle.
boss.explain: 英文：The brake pads have been wearing out unevenly due to a misaligned suspension. 意思：因為懸吊系統未對齊，煞車來令片一直磨損得很不平均。B「那麼我應該授權進行懸吊系統的全面更換嗎？」為最佳回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The autobiography is expected to be released globally next Tuesday.
options: A. The global economy is recovering slowly.
B. I can't wait to grab a copy from the bookstore.
C. She drives an automatic car to work.
D. Yes, Tuesday is a holiday.
boss.explain: 英文：The autobiography is expected to be released globally next Tuesday. 意思：這本自傳預計下週二在全球發行。B「我等不及要去書店買一本了」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The central conflict of the plot must have been inspired by your childhood trauma.
options: A. 許多讀者對小說中暴力的情節感到反感。
B. 這本童書的插畫充滿了生動鮮明的色彩。
C. 作者拒絕在訪談中透露任何個人的隱私。
D. 劇情的中心衝突一定是被你童年的創傷所啟發的。
boss.explain: 英文：The central conflict of the plot must have been inspired by your childhood trauma. 意思：劇情的中心衝突一定是被你童年的創傷所啟發的。trauma 指創傷。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Certain chapters are known to have been rewritten to appease the publishers.
options: A. It is a shame they sacrificed artistic integrity for sales.
B. The printer is out of paper again.
C. I have not read the latest newspaper yet.
D. He knows how to write a good email.
boss.explain: 英文：Certain chapters are known to have been rewritten to appease the publishers. 意思：某些章節據悉為了安撫出版商而被重寫了。A「很遺憾他們為了銷量犧牲了藝術的完整性」最為契合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The essential prerequisites for this internship are supposed to be strictly enforced.
options: A. 公司決定放寬實習生的招募條件以吸引更多人。
B. 這個實習計畫的必要先決條件理應被嚴格執行。
C. 所有實習生都會獲得一份全職工作的錄取通知。
D. 面試過程非常輕鬆，沒有任何嚴格的規定。
boss.explain: 英文：The essential prerequisites for this internship are supposed to be strictly enforced. 意思：這個實習計畫的必要先決條件理應被嚴格執行。prerequisite 為先決條件。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The selection committee must have been overwhelmed by the sheer volume of outstanding applications.
options: A. The volume of the speaker is too loud.
B. I downloaded a new application on my phone.
C. That definitely explains the long delay in announcing the results.
D. They selected a new chairman yesterday.
boss.explain: 英文：The selection committee must have been overwhelmed by the sheer volume of outstanding applications. 意思：評選委員會一定是被數量龐大的優秀申請件給淹沒了。C「這絕對解釋了為何公佈結果會拖延這麼久」最為適當。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The spectacular architecture on the ceiling must have taken decades to construct.
options: A. 博物館的屋頂因為年久失修而開始漏水。
B. 這座城市的摩天大樓都是在近年完工的。
C. 這裡的建築風格受到了現代藝術的強烈影響。
D. 天花板上壯觀的建築結構一定花了幾十年才建造完成。
boss.explain: 英文：The spectacular architecture on the ceiling must have taken decades to construct. 意思：天花板上壯觀的建築結構一定花了幾十年才建造完成。architecture 指建築結構，must have taken 表達推測花費的時間。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The archaeological excavations have been uncovering remnants of a forgotten civilization.
options: A. It is absolutely fascinating how much history is buried here.
B. I need to cover my car before it rains.
C. The construction workers forgot their tools.
D. This museum is closed on Mondays.
boss.explain: 英文：The archaeological excavations have been uncovering remnants of a forgotten civilization. 意思：這些考古挖掘工作一直不斷出土一個被遺忘文明的遺跡。A「這裡埋藏了多少歷史，真是令人極度著迷」最切題。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Supply Chain Insight: The sudden collapse of the major shipping firm is heavily rumored to have been orchestrated by a rival conglomerate. Smaller vendors have been suffering from extreme inventory shortages ever since. They must have relied entirely on a single logistics provider, ignoring the basic principle of diversification.
Q: What mistake did the smaller vendors make?
options: A. They orchestrated the firm's collapse.
B. They relied on a single logistics provider.
C. They diversified their inventory too much.
D. They ignored the rival conglomerate.
boss.explain: 文中指責較小的供應商「must have relied entirely on a single logistics provider」，犯了未分散風險的錯誤。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Not only ___ alternative raw materials, but the procurement team is also expected to secure lower import tariffs next quarter.
options: A. they have been sourcing
B. have they been sourcing
C. do they source
D. they source
boss.explain: Not only 置於句首時，後面的子句需要倒裝（助動詞移到主詞前），故選 have they been sourcing。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Health Abstract: Long-term dietary studies have been analyzing the correlation between sugar intake and early-onset diabetes. The metabolic disruption is firmly believed to have been triggered by highly processed ingredients. The food industry must have deliberately obscured the nutritional labels to maintain high sales volumes.
Q: What is the food industry accused of doing?
options: A. Analyzing dietary studies
B. Lowering sugar intake
C. Obscuring nutritional labels
D. Triggering early-onset diabetes directly
boss.explain: 短文中提到「must have deliberately obscured the nutritional labels」，指控食品業故意模糊營養標示。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Lease Dispute Summary: The commercial tenant has been demanding compensation for the water damage. The faulty plumbing is proven to have caused severe structural decay prior to the move-in date. The property inspector must have conducted a superficial evaluation during the initial handover.
Q: Why is the property inspector criticized?
options: A. For causing the water damage
B. For conducting a superficial evaluation
C. For demanding compensation
D. For moving in early
boss.explain: 短文中提到「must have conducted a superficial evaluation」，意即檢驗員只做了草率的檢查。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Scarcely ___ the new binding clause when the lessee realized it heavily favored the landlord's interests.
options: A. had the lawyer drafted
B. the lawyer had drafted
C. has the lawyer drafted
D. the lawyer has drafted
boss.explain: Scarcely 置於句首需倒裝，搭配 when，且主要子句為過去式（realized），故前方需用過去完成式倒裝 had + S + V-en。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Startup Analysis: The highly anticipated app is reported to have crashed completely during its live demonstration. Developers have been frantically releasing patches to contain the damage. The QA department must have bypassed the server load tests to meet the aggressive launch schedule set by the investors.
Q: What caused the live demonstration to fail?
options: A. The investors cancelled the launch.
B. The app crashed due to bypassed server load tests.
C. The developers released too many patches.
D. The live demonstration was poorly attended.
boss.explain: 文中說明應用程式崩潰，且推測是 QA 部門為了趕進度而跳過伺服器負載測試（bypassed the server load tests）。

boss.desc: 【字彙】To attract venture capital, a startup's business model must be highly ___, allowing it to grow exponentially without a proportional increase in costs.
options: A. bustling
B. sedentary
C. scalable
D. picturesque
boss.explain: scalable 意為「可擴展的」。新創的商業模式必須能擴大規模而成本不致於暴增。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Culture Column: The local government has been pouring funds into restoring the colonial-era architecture. The historical district is widely considered to have lost its authentic charm due to over-commercialization. The city planners must have prioritized lucrative tourist traps over genuine cultural preservation.
Q: What is the main criticism against the city planners?
options: A. They destroyed the colonial-era architecture.
B. They prioritized commercial tourist traps over cultural preservation.
C. They ran out of funds for the restoration.
D. They ignored the historical district entirely.
boss.explain: 文中批評「must have prioritized lucrative tourist traps over genuine cultural preservation」（將賺錢的觀光陷阱置於真正的文化保存之上）。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The region's unique ___, featuring a blend of indigenous spices and modern culinary techniques, has drawn food critics from all over the world.
options: A. traction
B. valuation
C. gastronomy
D. clause
boss.explain: gastronomy 意為「美食學、烹飪法」。結合當地香料與現代技術的美食吸引了全球評論家。

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Only after the audit was fully completed ___ that the startup's inflated valuation was entirely fabricated by the founders.
options: A. it was discovered
B. did they discover
C. they discovered
D. they have discovered
boss.explain: Only after 位於句首時，主要子句需倒裝。過去式倒裝為 did + S + V。

boss.desc:
【綜合】City Travel Guide: Tourists have been crowding the northern coastal town to witness its famed sunset. The iconic lighthouse is said to have guided countless lost sailors during the 19th century. Early settlers must have endured incredibly harsh winters without modern heating.
Q: What is true about the iconic lighthouse?
options: A. It was built to attract tourists.
B. It is currently being rebuilt.
C. It is said to have guided lost sailors in the past.
D. It was destroyed in the 19th century.
boss.explain: 文中提及「The iconic lighthouse is said to have guided countless lost sailors during the 19th century」。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The village is so ___, with its cobblestone streets and vibrant gardens, that it looks like a scene straight out of a fairy tale.
options: A. scalable
B. binding
C. picturesque
D. sedentary
boss.explain: picturesque 意為「如畫的、美麗的」，用來形容風景如童話般美麗。

boss.desc: 請唸出：正在被組裝
boss.speak: are being assembled

boss.desc: 請唸出：一定遺漏了
boss.speak: must have omitted

boss.desc: 請唸出：一直排練
boss.speak: have been rehearsing

boss.desc: 請唸出：正在退款中
boss.speak: is being refunded

boss.desc: 請唸出：一定延遲了
boss.speak: must have delayed it

boss.desc: 請唸出：你一定忽略了那個特定條款
boss.ans: YOU MUST HAVE OVERLOOKED THAT SPECIFIC CLAUSE
boss.speak: you must have overlooked that specific clause

boss.desc: 請唸出：一個有趣的軼事現在正被分享
boss.ans: AN AMUSING ANECDOTE IS BEING SHARED NOW
boss.speak: an amusing anecdote is being shared now

boss.desc: 請唸出：後勤工作正由他們處理
boss.ans: THE LOGISTICS ARE BEING HANDLED BY THEM
boss.speak: the logistics are being handled by them

boss.desc: 請唸出：她一直在分享一個有趣的軼事
boss.ans: SHE HAS BEEN SHARING AN INTERESTING ANECDOTE
boss.speak: she has been sharing an interesting anecdote

boss.desc: 請唸出：他們一定把這兩個地址搞混了
boss.ans: THEY MUST HAVE CONFUSED THE DIFFERENT ADDRESSES
boss.speak: they must have confused the different addresses

boss.desc: 請唸出：資金的分配正在被討論
boss.ans: THE ALLOCATION OF FUNDS IS BEING DISCUSSED
boss.speak: the allocation of funds is being discussed

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們一直在表達我們深深的感激
boss.ans: WE HAVE BEEN EXPRESSING OUR DEEP GRATITUDE
boss.speak: we have been expressing our deep gratitude

boss.speak: integration

boss.desc: 填空題：C L _ R I F I C _ T I _ N (澄清；說明)
boss.speak: clarification

boss.speak: consolidate

boss.speak: pertinent

boss.desc: 填空題：P _ R T _ N E N _ (相關的；恰當的)
boss.speak: pertinent

boss.speak: stipulate

boss.desc: 填空題：S T _ P U L _ T _ (規定；明確要求)
boss.speak: stipulate

boss.speak: mitigate
