boss.speak: prospective

boss.desc: 填空題：P R _ S P _ C T I V _ (潛在的；預期的)
boss.speak: prospective

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The correlation between sleep deprivation and cognitive decline has been rigorously documented by researchers.
options: A. 研究人員一直嚴格記錄睡眠不足與認知衰退之間的關聯性。
B. 睡眠不足一定導致了受試者嚴重的認知功能下降。
C. 關於睡眠與認知的研究正被學術界廣泛討論。
D. 研究人員必須證明睡眠不足會造成認知衰退。
boss.explain: 原句：The correlation between sleep deprivation and cognitive decline has been rigorously documented by researchers. 意思是「睡眠不足與認知衰退之間的關聯，已經被研究人員嚴格地記錄下來」。使用現在完成式的被動語態 (has been documented)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The erroneous billing charges must have been generated by a glitch in the automated system.
options: A. The system is being shut down permanently tomorrow.
B. Yes, our engineers have been trying to isolate the exact bug since Monday.
C. You must have intentionally overcharged the customers.
D. The billing statement has been mailed to your address.
boss.explain: 原句：The erroneous billing charges must have been generated by a glitch in the automated system.（錯誤的帳單費用一定是自動化系統中的小故障所產生的。）回應「是的，我們的工程師從週一就一直在試圖找出確切的錯誤」符合語境與複雜時態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The intricate embroidery on this haute couture gown is being meticulously crafted by artisans.
options: A. 這件高級訂製禮服上精美的刺繡正由工匠們一絲不苟地製作中。
B. 工匠們一直努力在期限前完成這件高級禮服的刺繡。
C. 這件禮服的刺繡一定花了工匠們好幾個月的時間。
D. 我們必須請最頂尖的工匠來完成這種精美的刺繡。
boss.explain: 原句：The intricate embroidery on this haute couture gown is being meticulously crafted by artisans. 意思是「這件高級訂製禮服上繁複的刺繡，正由工匠們一絲不苟地手工製作」。使用了現在進行式的被動語態 (is being crafted)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have the preliminary negotiations regarding the intellectual property transfer been progressing smoothly?
options: A. The property is being sold to a private investor.
B. They must have canceled the negotiation without telling us.
C. Actually, they have been stalling over the valuation of the patents.
D. The intellectual progress must have been evaluated.
boss.explain: 原句：Have the preliminary negotiations regarding the intellectual property transfer been progressing smoothly?（關於智慧財產權轉讓的初步談判進展順利嗎？）回應「事實上，他們一直在專利估值上拖延」最符合商業情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The standardized testing protocols must have been compromised during the administrative transition.
options: A. 標準化測驗的程序一定在行政交接期間遭到了破壞。
B. 學校一直在過渡期間努力維持標準化測驗的公平性。
C. 測驗程序正被教育局重新評估其有效性。
D. 行政團隊必須在交接前確保測驗不會遭到外洩。
boss.explain: 原句：The standardized testing protocols must have been compromised during the administrative transition. 意思是「標準化測試規程一定在行政過渡/交接期間遭到妥協/破壞了」。compromised 在此指「遭受損害/破壞」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The prolonged exposure to blue light has been scientifically linked to retinal strain.
options: A. The blue paint is being applied to the walls.
B. Therefore, protective eyewear is highly recommended by optometrists.
C. They must have strained their muscles during the workout.
D. We have been staring at the beautiful blue ocean.
boss.explain: 原句：The prolonged exposure to blue light has been scientifically linked to retinal strain.（長時間暴露在藍光下已經在科學上被證實與視網膜疲勞有關。）回應「因此，驗光師強烈建議配戴防護眼鏡」最符合健康講座主題。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Your roaming privileges are currently being suspended due to anomalous international activity.
options: A. 由於異常的國際活動，您的漫遊權限目前正被停用。
B. 我們一直懷疑您的帳號涉及異常的跨國詐騙活動。
C. 您的漫遊權限一定是因為出國太久而被取消了。
D. 您必須親自聯繫客服才能恢復國際漫遊服務。
boss.explain: 原句：Your roaming privileges are currently being suspended due to anomalous international activity. 意思是「您的漫遊特權/權限目前正因為異常的國際活動而被暫停」。(is being suspended)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The controversial silhouette of the winter jacket must have provoked a strong reaction from critics.
options: A. The critics have been praising traditional styles lately.
B. Yes, it was widely debated, but it's being sold out everywhere.
C. You must have forgotten to wear a jacket today.
D. The winter collection has been delayed until next year.
boss.explain: 原句：The controversial silhouette of the winter jacket must have provoked a strong reaction from critics.（這款冬季外套備受爭議的輪廓/剪裁一定引起了評論家強烈的反應。）回應「是的，它引起了廣泛討論，但現在到處都賣光了」最合邏輯。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A hostile bid has been secretly orchestrated by our biggest competitor to seize market dominance.
options: A. 我們最大的競爭對手一直秘密策劃惡意收購，以奪取市場主導權。
B. 競爭對手一定用非法的手段奪取了我們的市場份額。
C. 這個惡意出價正在被我們的董事會嚴厲拒絕。
D. 為了主導市場，我們必須秘密策劃收購對手。
boss.explain: 原句：A hostile bid has been secretly orchestrated by our biggest competitor to seize market dominance. 意思是「一個惡意出價（收購）已經被我們最大的競爭對手秘密策劃，以奪取市場主導地位」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The implementation of the inclusive pedagogy must have required extensive faculty retraining.
options: A. Faculty members have been complaining about the low salary.
B. Indeed, professional development sessions have been running for a whole semester.
C. The students are being retrained to pass the tests.
D. You must have implemented the wrong teaching method.
boss.explain: 原句：The implementation of the inclusive pedagogy must have required extensive faculty retraining.（實施包容性教學法一定需要教職員工進行廣泛的重新訓練。）回應「的確，專業發展課程已經進行了整整一個學期」最恰當。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The therapeutic benefits of this herbal remedy have been fiercely debated by medical professionals.
options: A. 這種草藥療法的治療效益一直受到醫療專業人員的激烈辯論。
B. 醫療專家一定早就知道這種草藥的潛在風險。
C. 這種草藥目前正被醫院廣泛用於治療重症病患。
D. 我們必須證明這種草藥具有醫學上的療效。
boss.explain: 原句：The therapeutic benefits of this herbal remedy have been fiercely debated by medical professionals. 意思是「這種草藥療法的療效一直被醫療專業人員激烈地爭論」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The encryption protocols on the legacy server are being systematically overhauled to prevent breaches.
options: A. The overhaul must have caused the data breach last week.
B. The legacy server has been completely shut down.
C. Good, we have been dealing with minor cyber threats recently.
D. You must have encrypted the password successfully.
boss.explain: 原句：The encryption protocols on the legacy server are being systematically overhauled to prevent breaches.（舊伺服器上的加密協定正被系統性地全面翻修以防止外洩。）回應「太好了，我們最近一直在處理輕微的網路威脅」最符合情境。

boss.desc:
【短文】Policy Update: We have been reviewing the impact of the new emission cap. The strict regulation is claimed to have spurred unprecedented innovation in battery storage. Startups that adapted quickly must have secured substantial government grants early on.
Q: What is the main outcome of the strict regulation?
options: A. Innovation in battery storage
B. Reduction of government grants
C. Collapse of the startup market
D. Increase in emission limits
boss.explain: 短文第二句提到「The strict regulation is claimed to have spurred unprecedented innovation in battery storage. (嚴格的法規被宣稱激發了電池儲能方面史無前例的創新。)」，故 A 為正確解答。

boss.desc:
【短文】Energy Critique: The utility provider has been raising tariffs without prior consultation. The sudden spike in electricity bills is projected to be challenged in court by consumer advocacy groups. The executives must have assumed the public would simply absorb the extra cost without resistance.
Q: What action will likely be taken against the tariff increase?
options: A. A new marketing campaign
B. A legal challenge in court
C. A public consultation event
D. A reduction in utility services
boss.explain: 文中指出「The sudden spike in electricity bills is projected to be challenged in court (預期將在法庭上受到挑戰)」，即訴諸法律行動。

boss.desc:
【短文】Academic Journal: Researchers have been tracking the long-term effects of bilingual education. Cognitive flexibility is proven to have been greatly enhanced in students who started early. Policymakers who cut funding for language programs must have disregarded these empirical findings.
Q: What is a proven benefit of bilingual education mentioned?
options: A. Cheaper program funding
B. Enhanced cognitive flexibility
C. More physical strength
D. Faster reading speed in one language
boss.explain: 文中的「Cognitive flexibility is proven to have been greatly enhanced」直接對應到選項 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Reform Editorial: We have been witnessing a steady decline in vocational training enrollment. The societal obsession with university degrees is largely blamed for this trend. The Ministry of Education must have neglected to promote the lucrative career paths available in skilled trades.
Q: Why is vocational enrollment declining according to the editorial?
options: A. Society's focus on university degrees
B. The high cost of vocational training
C. The lack of skilled instructors
D. The low salary of trade jobs
boss.explain: 文章表示「The societal obsession with university degrees is largely blamed for this trend (社會對大學學歷的迷戀很大程度上是這個趨勢的原因)」。

boss.desc:
【短文】Quality Assurance Report: The front desk staff has been undergoing intensive conflict resolution training. A recent altercation in the lobby is confirmed to have been handled unprofessionally. The duty supervisor must have lacked the necessary experience to de-escalate the situation effectively.
Q: Why is the staff undergoing training?
options: A. To learn how to use the new software
B. Because a situation was handled poorly
C. To prepare for the tourist season
D. Because they requested a pay raise
boss.explain: 因為近期大廳的爭執 (altercation) 被證實處理得不專業 (handled unprofessionally)，所以人員正在接受衝突解決訓練。

boss.desc:
【短文】Hospitality Trends: Boutique hotels have been capitalizing on the demand for eco-friendly tourism. Their use of sustainable toiletries is widely praised by environmentally conscious travelers. Larger chains must have noticed this lucrative niche, as they are rapidly adopting similar practices.
Q: Why are larger chains adopting sustainable practices?
options: A. To tap into a profitable market niche
B. To reduce their cleaning staff
C. To comply with strict government laws
D. To avoid being sued by travelers
boss.explain: lucrative niche 意指「利潤豐厚的利基市場」，大型連鎖飯店必定是注意到了這個商機才會跟進採用永續做法。

boss.desc:
【短文】Court Document: The plaintiff has been attempting to secure an astronomical sum for damages. However, the patent in question is considered to have been too vague to enforce effectively. The original creators must have poorly defined the technical boundaries of their invention.
Q: Why is the patent difficult to enforce?
options: A. The damages requested are too high
B. Its technical boundaries were poorly defined
C. The plaintiff lost the original document
D. The judge refused to read it
boss.explain: 文中指出「The original creators must have poorly defined the technical boundaries (原創者必定是對技術邊界的定義太差)」，導致專利太模糊而難以執行。

boss.desc:
【短文】Arbitration Update: The mediation board has been striving to resolve the software copyright conflict peacefully. The proprietary code is verified to have been independently developed, not stolen. The accusing party must have jumped to conclusions based solely on the superficial similarities in the final product.
Q: What did the mediation board verify?
options: A. The software was stolen
B. The code was independently developed
C. The accusing party was correct
D. The final product was superficial
boss.explain: 短文第二句「The proprietary code is verified to have been independently developed (專有程式碼被驗證為獨立開發)」為解答依據。

boss.desc:
【短文】Urban Development Review: We have been assessing the social impact of the new luxury high-rises. The affordable housing quota is alleged to have been completely ignored by the developers. The oversight committee must have turned a blind eye to these egregious violations during the approval process.
Q: What are the developers accused of ignoring?
options: A. The structural safety codes
B. The affordable housing requirement
C. The approval process rules
D. The environmental guidelines
boss.explain: 文中提及「The affordable housing quota is alleged to have been completely ignored (據稱可負擔住宅的配額被完全忽視)」，對應選項 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Public Transport Update: The transport authority has been extending the light rail network to the outer suburbs. The improved connectivity is projected to be a major catalyst for suburban economic growth. Residents who previously relied on cars must have welcomed the reduction in their daily commute times.
Q: What is expected to boost suburban economic growth?
options: A. More cars on the road
B. Better transport connectivity
C. A new shopping mall
D. The transport authority's headquarters
boss.explain: 「The improved connectivity is projected to be a major catalyst for suburban economic growth (改善的連結性預計將成為郊區經濟增長的主要催化劑)」，因此選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Heritage Newsletter: Activists have been campaigning to save the century-old library from demolition. The architectural integrity of the building is recognized to have been compromised by years of neglect. The city administration must have intentionally withheld maintenance funds to justify its eventual destruction.
Q: Why was the building neglected according to activists?
options: A. To provide an excuse for tearing it down
B. Because the city had no money at all
C. Because activists protested against maintenance
D. To preserve its original ancient look
boss.explain: 文中寫道市政府必定是「intentionally withheld maintenance funds to justify its eventual destruction (故意扣留維修資金以合理化其最終的拆毀)」，選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Market Watch: The petroleum giant has been shedding its less profitable assets. The recent divestment is widely believed to have been forced by aggressive shareholder activism. The board must have realized that fossil fuel investments are becoming a long-term liability.
Q: What forced the divestment?
options: A. A new energy law
B. Aggressive shareholder activism
C. High oil prices
D. A lack of fossil fuels
boss.explain: 由句子「The recent divestment is widely believed to have been forced by aggressive shareholder activism (最近的資產撤資普遍被認為是受到激進股東行動主義的逼迫)」可知答案為 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Management Memo: We have been analyzing the recent wave of negative online reviews. The malfunctioning air conditioners are determined to have been the primary source of frustration. The maintenance crew must have skipped the annual servicing routine during the off-season.
Q: What was the main source of guest frustration?
options: A. Broken air conditioners
B. The online review system
C. The off-season rates
D. The front desk staff
boss.explain: 文中的「malfunctioning air conditioners (故障的冷氣機)」直接對應到選項 A (Broken air conditioners)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: All expired pharmaceutical products are legally required to be disposed of properly.
options: A. 法律規定所有過期的藥品都必須妥善處理。
B. 過期藥品一直被藥局合法地重新販售。
C. 法律規定過期藥品不能隨意販售給一般人。
D. 所有藥品都必須在過期前合法地丟棄。
boss.explain: 「All expired pharmaceutical products are legally required to be disposed of properly.」意思是「法律規定所有過期的藥品都必須妥善處理。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The doctor must have adjusted the dosage without notifying the pharmacy.
options: A. The pharmacy has been relocating recently.
B. That explains why the prescription looks different.
C. The dosage is being measured accurately.
D. He must have forgotten to take his medicine.
boss.explain: 說話者推測：「The doctor must have adjusted the dosage without notifying the pharmacy.（醫生一定是沒有通知藥局就調整了劑量。）」最合理的回應是難怪處方箋看起來不一樣 (B)。（重點文法：must have done）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The compromised funds are anticipated to be fully refunded within ten business days.
options: A. 被盜用的資金一定已經在十個工作天內退還了。
B. 我們一直在努力確保被盜用的資金能全額退還。
C. 預計被盜用的資金將在十個工作天內全額退還。
D. 您必須在十個工作天內申請退還被盜用的資金。
boss.explain: 「The compromised funds are anticipated to be fully refunded within ten business days.」意思是「預計被盜用的資金將在十個工作天內全額退還。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: He must have unknowingly provided his sensitive banking details to the imposter.
options: A. The bank has been freezing his account since Monday.
B. His details are expected to be verified soon.
C. I must have met the imposter before.
D. That's terrible; he probably thought it was a legitimate call.
boss.explain: 說話者推測：「He must have unknowingly provided his sensitive banking details to the imposter.（他一定是在不知情的情況下把敏感的銀行資料給了冒名頂替者。）」最合理的回應是感嘆並推測他以為那是合法電話 (D)。（重點文法：must have done）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The event organizers must have underestimated the sheer volume of international participants.
options: A. 活動主辦方一定低估了國際參與者的龐大數量。
B. 國際參與者的數量目前正被活動主辦方低估。
C. 活動主辦方一直無法估算國際參與者的數量。
D. 活動主辦方必須限制國際參與者的總數量。
boss.explain: 「The event organizers must have underestimated the sheer volume of international participants.」意思是「活動主辦方一定低估了國際參與者的龐大數量。」（重點文法：must have done）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: How long have your sales representatives been explaining the intricate features?
options: A. The intricate features are being redesigned.
B. For over forty minutes; the client is very curious.
C. They must have forgotten the product details.
D. The representatives have been to the exhibition twice.
boss.explain: 說話者詢問：「How long have your sales representatives been explaining the intricate features?（你們的業務代表解釋這些複雜功能多久了？）」最合理的回應是回答時間長度並解釋原因 (B)。（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The primary investigator must have overlooked the subtle statistical anomaly.
options: A. The anomaly is being corrected by the software.
B. We have been gathering statistical data for a week.
C. He's usually very meticulous, so that's quite surprising.
D. You must have been the primary investigator.
boss.explain: 說話者推測：「The primary investigator must have overlooked the subtle statistical anomaly.（首席研究員一定忽略了那個細微的統計異常。）」最合理的回應是訝異於這個通常很細心的人會犯錯 (C)。（重點文法：must have done）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We have been conducting longitudinal studies to assess the long-term cognitive impacts.
options: A. 為了評估長期認知影響，我們必須進行縱向研究。
B. 長期認知影響一定已經透過縱向研究被評估了。
C. 這些縱向研究預計將徹底改變長期認知影響。
D. 我們一直在進行縱向研究，以評估長期的認知影響。
boss.explain: 「We have been conducting longitudinal studies to assess the long-term cognitive impacts.」意思是「我們一直在進行縱向研究，以評估長期的認知影響。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The emergency responders have been coordinating the rescue efforts via radio.
options: A. 緊急救援人員一定已經透過無線電完成了救援。
B. 透過無線電的救援行動目前正受到嚴格監控。
C. 緊急救援人員一直在透過無線電協調救援行動。
D. 緊急救援人員必須透過無線電來指揮所有人。
boss.explain: 「The emergency responders have been coordinating the rescue efforts via radio.」意思是「緊急救援人員一直在透過無線電協調救援行動。」（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: These precautionary measures are being implemented to prevent future structural failures.
options: A. 未來的結構性損壞一定是因為這些預防措施而造成的。
B. 我們一直在研究如何防止未來的結構性損壞。
C. 為了防止未來的結構性損壞，必須停止這些措施。
D. 正在實施這些預防措施，以防止未來的結構性損壞。
boss.explain: 「These precautionary measures are being implemented to prevent future structural failures.」意思是「正在實施這些預防措施，以防止未來的結構性損壞。」（重點文法：複雜被動）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The occupants must have panicked and abandoned their personal belongings in the hallways.
options: A. 裡面的住戶一定是因為恐慌而把私人物品丟在走廊上。
B. 我們一直在走廊上尋找住戶遺留下來的私人物品。
C. 走廊上的私人物品預計將被歸還給恐慌的住戶。
D. 住戶們必須在恐慌中把私人物品留在走廊上。
boss.explain: 「The occupants must have panicked and abandoned their personal belongings in the hallways.」意思是「裡面的住戶一定是因為恐慌而把私人物品丟在走廊上。」（重點文法：must have done）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have the floor wardens been instructing everyone to use the stairwells instead of elevators?
options: A. The elevators are expected to be fixed tomorrow.
B. Yes, they are standing by the lifts to redirect the crowd.
C. I must have taken the wrong stairwell earlier.
D. The floor wardens have been evacuated safely.
boss.explain: 說話者詢問：「Have the floor wardens been instructing everyone to use the stairwells instead of elevators?（樓層疏散員有一直指示大家走樓梯不要搭電梯嗎？）」最合理的回應是肯定並說明他們正在電梯旁引導人群 (B)。（重點文法：現在完成進行式）

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Are the regional managers still debating the budget cuts?
B: Yes, they ___ over the disproportionate funding allocated to the marketing team for hours.
options: A. argue
B. have been arguing
C. are argued
D. will have argued
boss.explain: for hours 表示動作從過去持續到現在，且雙方仍在爭論，應使用現在完成進行式 have been arguing。

boss.desc: 【句子】The CEO's abrupt resignation is widely alleged ___ by a severe disagreement with the board regarding the company's future direction.
options: A. to have been prompted
B. prompting
C. to prompt
D. prompt
boss.explain: is widely alleged to have been + p.p. 表示「被廣泛指稱已經被...引發」，符合複雜被動語態且表示對過去事件的描述。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: The competitor's new smartwatch is completely flawless!
B: I agree. Their R&D department ___ an unprecedented amount of resources into resolving the battery issues.
options: A. should pour
B. can pour
C. must have poured
D. will pour
boss.explain: 對手產品完美，推測其研發部門「必定投入了」空前資源，用 must have + p.p.。

boss.desc: 【句子】To survive in a highly competitive market, established corporations must continuously ___ their business models to adapt to changing consumer behaviors.
options: A. dismantle
B. fluctuate
C. obscure
D. revolutionize
boss.explain: revolutionize (徹底改變/革新) 商業模式以適應消費者行為。dismantle (拆除)、fluctuate (波動)、obscure (使模糊) 皆不合語意。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Has the tourism committee finalized the new preservation guidelines?
B: Not yet. They ___ ways to alleviate the pressure on the historic sites without deterring visitors.
options: A. have been exploring
B. explored
C. are explored
D. will explore
boss.explain: Not yet 表示動作尚未完成且仍在進行，使用現在完成進行式 have been exploring 表示「一直都在探索」。

boss.desc:
【短文】Urban Tourism Report: We have been closely monitoring the socio-economic impacts of the short-term rental boom. The displacement of long-term residents is confirmed to have been exacerbated by unregulated platforms. The municipal authorities must have prioritized lucrative tax revenues over housing stability for local citizens. 
Q: What is a major criticism leveled against the municipal authorities?
options: A. They banned short-term rental platforms entirely.
B. They valued financial gains more than local housing stability.
C. They failed to collect taxes from tourists.
D. They forced long-term residents to rent out their homes.
boss.explain: 文中提到當局 must have prioritized lucrative tax revenues over housing stability (必定是將豐厚的稅收置於住房穩定之上)，即重視財務收益勝過居住穩定。

boss.desc:
【短文】NGO Strategic Review: The foundation has been channeling funds into renewable energy projects in developing nations. The reliance on fossil fuels is considered to have hindered economic resilience in these regions. The previous administration must have overlooked the vital importance of sustainable infrastructure when drafting their development plans. 
Q: According to the review, what hindered economic resilience?
options: A. The foundation's funding strategy.
B. The reliance on fossil fuels.
C. The new sustainable infrastructure.
D. The overpopulation in developing nations.
boss.explain: 文中明確寫出 The reliance on fossil fuels is considered to have hindered economic resilience (對化石燃料的依賴被認為阻礙了經濟韌性)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Market Trend Analysis: Analysts have been scrutinizing the sudden decline of prominent fast-fashion brands. The shift toward ethical consumption is shown to have dismantled their once-dominant market position. The brand executives must have been oblivious to the growing environmental concerns among younger demographics. 
Q: Why did the fast-fashion brands lose their dominant position?
options: A. A sudden increase in raw material costs.
B. Consumers shifting towards ethical consumption.
C. The executives launching too many new designs.
D. A lack of younger demographics in the market.
boss.explain: 文中提到 The shift toward ethical consumption is shown to have dismantled their once-dominant market position (向道德消費的轉變瓦解了他們的市場主導地位)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Employee Handbook Update: The HR team has been revising the clauses regarding intellectual property. Any software developed during company hours is stipulated to be the sole property of the corporation. Former employees who attempted to patent such software must have failed to read the explicit constraints in their original contracts. 
Q: What is true about software developed during company hours?
options: A. It belongs exclusively to the corporation.
B. It can be patented by the individual developer.
C. It is usually ignored by the HR team.
D. It must be shared with former employees.
boss.explain: 文中寫道 is stipulated to be the sole property of the corporation (規定為公司的唯一財產)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Medical Research News: Scientists have been conducting clinical trials on a new mRNA therapy. The experimental treatment is purported to have alleviated severe symptoms of autoimmune disorders. The pharmaceutical company must have bypassed some preliminary testing phases to fast-track its release. 
Q: What is the pharmaceutical company suspected of doing?
options: A. Fabricating the clinical trial results.
B. Skipping certain early testing stages to speed up the release.
C. Selling the therapy at an inflated price.
D. Ignoring the symptoms of autoimmune disorders.
boss.explain: 文中提到 must have bypassed some preliminary testing phases to fast-track its release (必定是跳過了一些初步測試階段以加快上市)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Policy Critique: The aviation authority has been attempting to reduce noise pollution around urban airports. The new flight path regulations are known to have disproportionately affected low-income neighborhoods. The planners must have intentionally routed the air traffic away from affluent areas to avoid political backlash. 
Q: What is the main criticism of the new flight path regulations?
options: A. They increased overall noise pollution in the city.
B. They unfairly impacted lower-income residential areas.
C. They caused multiple flights to be delayed.
D. They were rejected by the affluent neighborhoods.
boss.explain: 文中提到 disproportionately affected low-income neighborhoods (不成比例地影響了低收入社區)，因此選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】NGO Impact Report: Our volunteers have been dispensing essential medicines in the conflict zones for months. The local healthcare system is widely acknowledged to have collapsed completely due to the ongoing embargo. The international mediators must have severely misjudged the devastating humanitarian toll when they imposed the sanctions. 
Q: What caused the local healthcare system to collapse?
options: A. The lack of volunteers.
B. The ongoing embargo.
C. The distribution of expired medicines.
D. A sudden outbreak of a new virus.
boss.explain: 文中明確寫出 to have collapsed completely due to the ongoing embargo (由於持續的禁運而完全崩潰)。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你的奉獻今天正在被表彰。
boss.ans: YOUR COMMITMENT IS BEING RECOGNIZED TODAY
boss.speak: your commitment is being recognized today

boss.desc: 請唸出：她一定是無意中聽到了我們的對話。

boss.speak: the directive is being modified currently

boss.desc: 請唸出：他們一直在討論好幾個小時了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：她一定是推斷出了真相。

boss.ans: THEY HAVE BEEN DISPLAYING COMMENDABLE BEHAVIOR

boss.desc: 請唸出：規則正不經意地被違反。

boss.speak: the rules are being inadvertently violated

boss.desc: 請唸出：你一定是故意隱瞞它的。
boss.ans: YOU MUST HAVE DELIBERATELY CONCEALED IT

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The cleanup crews have been working tirelessly to restore power to the grid.
options: A. 清潔人員已經完成了市區街道的垃圾清掃工作。
B. 發電廠正在努力增加電網系統的供電容量。
C. 清理小組一直不知疲倦地工作，以恢復電網的供電。
D. 由於持續的停電，工作人員被迫暫停所有的清理工作。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：清理小組一直不知疲倦地工作，以恢復電網的供電。原句：The cleanup crews have been working tirelessly to restore power to the grid.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The sudden flash flood must have caught many unaware drivers by surprise.
options: A. Flash photography is not allowed here.
B. He was caught stealing from the store.
C. Driving at night requires more attention.
D. Absolutely, the water level rose incredibly fast.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：突如其來的山洪爆發一定讓許多毫無防備的駕駛措手不及。原句：The sudden flash flood must have caught many unaware drivers by surprise. 選項 D「絕對是，水位上升得快得難以置信」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A strict curfew is highly likely to be imposed on the flooded regions.
options: A. 極大可能會對淹水地區實施嚴格的宵禁。
B. 淹水地區的居民已經被要求立即撤離。
C. 警察正在淹水災區實施嚴格的交通管制。
D. 政府決定取消災區原本實施的夜間宵禁。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：極大可能會對淹水地區實施嚴格的宵禁。原句：A strict curfew is highly likely to be imposed on the flooded regions.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: They have been striving to master the core concepts of the new marketing strategy.
options: A. The new market is located downtown.
B. It is a steep learning curve, but they will get there.
C. Mastering a musical instrument takes years.
D. The strategy was completely abandoned.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：他們一直努力掌握新行銷策略的核心概念。原句：They have been striving to master the core concepts of the new marketing strategy. 選項 B「這是一段陡峭的學習曲線（學習難度高），但他們會達成的」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The attendees must have been overwhelmed by the vast amount of technical jargon.
options: A. 參加者抱怨會議中缺乏具體的技術細節。
B. 技術人員成功地向參加者解釋了複雜的術語。
C. 參加者一定是被大量專業的技術術語給壓垮（搞得不知所措）了。
D. 講者刻意減少了簡報中專業術語的使用量。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：參加者一定是被大量專業的技術術語給壓垮（搞得不知所措）了。原句：The attendees must have been overwhelmed by the vast amount of technical jargon.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The entire certification process is designed to be completed entirely online.
options: A. I need to print out the physical certificate.
B. Online gaming has become very popular.
C. The designer won an award for the website.
D. That will certainly make it convenient for remote employees.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：整個認證流程被設計成完全在線上完成。原句：The entire certification process is designed to be completed entirely online. 選項 D「這肯定會為遠端員工帶來便利」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Art historians have been disputing the true authenticity of this portrait.
options: A. 藝術史學家們一直在爭論這幅肖像畫的真實性（真偽）。
B. 歷史學家們已經證實這幅肖像畫是偽造的。
C. 這幅肖像畫背後的歷史故事讓許多學者感到著迷。
D. 博物館決定無限期展出這幅備受爭議的畫作。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：藝術史學家們一直在爭論這幅肖像畫的真實性（真偽）。原句：Art historians have been disputing the true authenticity of this portrait.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The original colors must have faded significantly due to prolonged sunlight exposure.
options: A. Sunlight is a great natural source of Vitamin D.
B. Yes, the ultraviolet rays can be incredibly damaging to pigments.
C. Colorful paintings are usually more expensive.
D. The gallery stays open until the sun goes down.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：由於長時間的陽光照射，原本的顏色一定已經明顯褪色了。原句：The original colors must have faded significantly due to prolonged sunlight exposure. 選項 B「對，紫外線對顏料的破壞力極強」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The newly discovered relics are slated to be exhibited in the grand hall.
options: A. 新發現的遺跡將被永久保存在地下的儲藏室中。
B. 博物館大廳正在進行翻修以容納更多遊客。
C. 新發現的文物預計將在大廳進行展出。
D. 考古團隊在大廳底下發掘出了新的古物。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：新發現的文物預計將在大廳展出。原句：The newly discovered relics are slated to be exhibited in the grand hall.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The final draft of the contract is supposed to be signed before midnight.
options: A. I will draft a letter to the manager soon.

C. The contract is full of grammatical errors.
D. Then we'd better review the terms one last time.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：合約的最終草案理應在午夜前簽署。原句：The final draft of the contract is supposed to be signed before midnight. 選項 D「那我們最好最後再檢查一次條款」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The counterpart must have realized that we hold the upper hand in this deal.
options: A. 對方一定意識到了我們在這筆交易中佔了上風。
B. 我們的對手拒絕承認我們提出的所有交易條件。
C. 談判對手終於明白他們在這筆交易中握有優勢。
D. 我們必須讓對方相信這是一場公平的交易。
boss.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：對方（談判對手）一定意識到了我們在這筆交易中佔了上風。原句：The counterpart must have realized that we hold the upper hand in this deal.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: A mutually beneficial alliance is believed to be favored by the board.
options: A. The blackboard needs to be wiped clean.
B. That makes sense; a win-win scenario reduces long-term risks.
C. I don't believe in alien alliances at all.
D. They favored a much more aggressive approach last year.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：董事會據信傾向於建立互利互惠的聯盟。原句：A mutually beneficial alliance is believed to be favored by the board. 選項 B「這很合理；雙贏的局面能降低長期風險」最適合。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Corporate Psychology Column: Middle management has been enduring an unprecedented level of scrutiny from both executives and subordinates. This intense pressure is empirically proven to have diminished their decision-making efficacy. The HR department's failure to intervene early must have exacerbated the organizational paralysis currently plaguing the company.
Q: Which of the following best describes the current state of middle management?
options: A. They are experiencing high pressure which negatively impacts their choices.
B. They have been successfully hiding their stress from the HR department.
C. They are scrutinizing the executives and subordinates excessively.
D. They have resolved the organizational paralysis.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章指出巨大的壓力被證實削弱了他們決策的效能 (diminished their decision-making efficacy)，對應選項 A 的 negatively impacts their choices。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Healthcare Economics: The federal government has been heavily subsidizing the domestic production of essential medical supplies. The reliance on foreign imports is universally acknowledged to have exposed the nation to critical shortages during the pandemic. The previous administration must have drastically underestimated the vulnerability of a globalized medical supply chain.
Q: What is the main reason the government is subsidizing domestic medical production?
options: A. To eliminate the need for any future medical research.
B. To reduce the vulnerability caused by relying on foreign imports.
C. To punish the previous administration for their mistakes.
D. To increase the profits of foreign medical suppliers.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章提到依賴外國進口使國家在疫情期間面臨嚴重短缺，前政府低估了全球化供應鏈的脆弱性，因此現在政府大量補貼國內生產以減少這種依賴。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Architecture Review: For decades, city planners have been advocating for the integration of green spaces into high-density commercial zones. The concrete-heavy aesthetics of the 1980s are now considered to have significantly contributed to the urban heat island effect. The original developers must have prioritized maximum rentable floor space over environmental sustainability.
Q: What is a negative impact of the 1980s architectural style mentioned in the text?
options: A. It reduced the total rentable floor space.
B. It contributed to the urban heat island effect.
C. It required too much green space integration.
D. It forced city planners to resign.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到 1980 年代以混凝土為主的風格被認為顯著地促成了「城市熱島效應 (urban heat island effect)」。

boss.desc:
【綜合】E-Commerce Dispute: The platform's arbitration team has been mediating a complex dispute between a premium vendor and a logistics partner. The perishable goods are confirmed to have been improperly stored during transit, resulting in massive spoilage. The logistics company must have deactivated the temperature sensors to save on fuel consumption.
Q: What is the logistics company suspected of doing?
options: A. Selling the perishable goods to another vendor.
B. Bribing the arbitration team.
C. Turning off the temperature sensors to save fuel.
D. Refusing to transport the premium goods.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文末推測「The logistics company must have deactivated the temperature sensors to save on fuel consumption.（物流公司一定為了節省燃料而關閉了溫度感測器）。」

boss.desc: 【語法結構】Not only ___ a profound transformation in workplace dynamics, but the hybrid model is also expected to redefine commercial real estate demand.
options: A. the pandemic has triggered
B. has the pandemic triggered
C. triggered the pandemic
D. the pandemic triggering
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：Not only 置於句首時，其後的子句必須倒裝，因此助動詞 has 要移到主詞 the pandemic 之前。

boss.desc: 【綜合文法】The intricate legal documents ___ by the compliance officers for weeks, yet the jurisdictional boundaries remain largely undefined.
options: A. have been scrutinizing
B. are scrutinizing
C. have been being scrutinized
D. have been scrutinized
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文件是「被審查」，加上 for weeks 表示持續一段時間，嚴格的現在完成進行被動態非常罕見且笨重，通常以現在完成被動態 (have been scrutinized) 代替來表達已完成或持續被動的狀態。A和B為主動，C過於冗贅，D最自然。

boss.desc:
【綜合】Trade Sanctions: International watchdogs have been monitoring the clandestine shipment of prohibited technologies. The sensitive equipment is widely reported to have been routed through multiple shell companies to obscure its final destination. The rogue state must have established a highly sophisticated smuggling network right under the authorities' noses.
Q: How did the rogue state hide the final destination of the equipment?
options: A. By destroying the equipment during transit.
B. By bribing the international watchdogs.
C. By routing the shipment through various shell companies.
D. By openly declaring it as agricultural machinery.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中明確指出設備被廣泛報導是 routed through multiple shell companies（透過多家空殼公司轉運）以掩蓋最終目的地。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The massive data breach in the healthcare system is highly suspected ___ by a sophisticated phishing email targeted at senior physicians.
options: A. to have been initiated
B. initiating
C. to initiate
D. is initiated
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：is suspected to... 接不定詞，且引起資料外洩是過去發生的被動事件，故用完成被動不定詞 to have been initiated。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Did the sellers agree to the new platform fee structure?
B: No, they are furious. They ___ a mass boycott against the e-commerce site for the past forty-eight hours.
options: A. are organized
B. have been organizing
C. organize
D. will have organized
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：for the past forty-eight hours 提示動作從過去持續到現在，應選現在完成進行式 have been organizing。

boss.desc: 【推測語氣】The entire structural framework collapsed during the minor earthquake. The chief engineer ___ the seismic stress tests completely.
options: A. should ignore
B. must have ignored
C. is ignoring
D. will ignore
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：對過去發生的災難做強烈推論，工程師「一定忽略了」抗震測試，用 must have + p.p.。

boss.desc:
【短文】Therapeutic Architecture: Researchers have been studying how physical environments affect patient recovery rates. Rooms with ample natural light are proven to have accelerated healing processes in post-operative patients. Traditional hospitals, with their dim, maze-like corridors, must have inadvertently prolonged the recovery times of millions.
Q: What is a proven benefit of ample natural light in hospitals?
options: A. It reduces the hospital's electricity bills.
B. It makes the hospital corridors easier to navigate.
C. It speeds up the healing process for patients after surgery.
D. It allows researchers to conduct studies more easily.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及 proven to have accelerated healing processes in post-operative patients（被證實加速了術後病人的復原過程）。

boss.desc: 【字彙】To ensure the new vaccine is accessible, the government is trying to remove any bureaucratic ___ that might slow down its distribution.
options: A. incentive
B. synergy
C. impediment
D. proxy
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：impediment 意為「障礙、阻礙」。移除官僚障礙 (bureaucratic impediment) 才能加速疫苗發放。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The platform's new algorithm is highly ___, adapting to individual user preferences in real time to maximize engagement.
options: A. sluggish
B. stagnant
C. versatile
D. obsolete
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：versatile 意為「多才多藝的、多功能的、適應性強的」。演算法能即時適應偏好，故選此字。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The deposit must have been refunded to your original payment method yesterday.
options: A. The refund is being processed by the manager.
B. I will check my bank statement to confirm that.
C. I have been paying for the rental deposit daily.
D. The deposit is expected to be collected upon arrival.
boss.explain: The deposit must have been refunded to your original payment method yesterday. (押金昨天一定已經退還到您原本的付款方式了。) 最適合的回應是 B (我會查看我的銀行對帳單來確認這一點。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The collision damage waiver is intended to minimize your financial LIABILITY.
options: A. 碰撞損害免責條款旨在減少您的財務責任
B. 我們一直試圖減少碰撞事故中的財務責任
C. 財務責任一定會因為碰撞事故而大幅增加
D. 碰撞損害的賠償目前正在被保險公司評估
boss.explain: The collision damage waiver is intended to minimize your financial liability. (碰撞損害免責條款旨在減少您的財務責任。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The server outage must have prevented several attendees from joining the session.
options: A. The servers have been running flawlessly all morning.
B. Attendees are expected to arrive at the venue shortly.
C. The presentation is being broadcast from a remote location.
D. We should send them a recorded copy as an apology.
boss.explain: The server outage must have prevented several attendees from joining the session. (伺服器中斷一定阻礙了幾位與會者加入會議。) 最適合的回應是 D (我們應該發送錄影檔給他們作為道歉。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We have been transmitting this live feed globally to reach a wider audience.
options: A. 為了接觸更廣大的觀眾，我們一直在全球傳送這個直播畫面
B. 這個直播畫面預計會對全球觀眾進行廣播
C. 這個直播畫面一定已經觸及了全球的觀眾
D. 全球直播的畫面正在被技術團隊進行調整
boss.explain: We have been transmitting this live feed globally to reach a wider audience. (為了接觸更廣大的觀眾，我們一直在全球傳送這個直播畫面。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The raw materials are scheduled to be transported to the secondary facility.
options: A. The secondary facility must have been closed down.
B. Have they finalized the shipping logs for those items?
C. The materials have been extracted from the main factory.
D. The raw materials are being heavily guarded right now.
boss.explain: The raw materials are scheduled to be transported to the secondary facility. (原物料預定被運送到第二廠區。) 最適合的回應是 B (他們完成那些物品的運送日誌了嗎？)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Our overall production EFFICIENCY has been improving steadily.
options: A. 生產效率一定在最近的升級後有所提升
B. 我們的生產效率預計會在下個季度達到高峰
C. 我們整體的生產效率一直在穩定提升
D. 生產過程的效率目前正在被重新評估
boss.explain: Our overall production efficiency has been improving steadily. (我們整體的生產效率一直在穩定提升。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The constant pressure must have taken a toll on their mental stability.
options: A. The pressure is being applied to the main pipes.
B. I have been taking a toll on my finances lately.
C. The mental health clinic is scheduled to open soon.
D. That's why we need to implement stress-relief programs.
boss.explain: The constant pressure must have taken a toll on their mental stability. (持續的壓力一定對他們的心理穩定造成了負面影響。) 最適合的回應是 D (這就是為什麼我們需要實施減壓計畫。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Physical fatigue is often perceived to be a SYMPTOM of chronic stress.
options: A. 身體的疲勞通常被認為是慢性壓力的症狀
B. 慢性壓力一定會導致身體極度疲勞
C. 我們一直將身體疲勞歸咎於慢性壓力
D. 疲勞症狀預期會隨著壓力減輕而消失
boss.explain: Physical fatigue is often perceived to be a symptom of chronic stress. (身體的疲勞通常被認為是慢性壓力的症狀。)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: You must have forgotten to lock the backdoor when you left.
options: A. The backdoor is scheduled to be replaced tomorrow.
B. I'm so sorry, I'll make sure to double-check it next time.
C. We have been leaving the front door open for fresh air.
D. The locks are being inspected by a professional locksmith.
boss.explain: You must have forgotten to lock the backdoor when you left. (你離開時一定忘了鎖後門。) 最適合的回應是 B (非常抱歉，下次我一定會再次確認。)
